items.title: Elden Ring On Switch 2 Is A Compromise, But It’s A Surprisingly Good One
items.summary: Elden Ring was in rough shape on Switch 2 when people first tried it out last year, leading publisher Bandai N

content.v: Elden Ring was in rough shape on Switch 2 when people first tried it out last year, leading publisher Bandai Namco to significantly delay its launch plans . It's now 2026, and ahead of its new release date of August 28, has that extra time in the development oven helped smooth out Elden Ring on the Nintendo hybrid console? Yes--but only to a certain point.

Senior video producer Jake Dekker has spent over a week with the game, playing it in both docked and handheld modes. The key takeaway is that Elden Ring runs at a consistent frame rate, but not the highest one.

"While there are certainly frame rate drops, it never hits the lows that we saw in some of that preview footage," Dekker explained. It runs a lot better. That being said, the frame rate is still far from perfect. I've done most of my playing docked, but I've also done some handheld, and you definitely notice those frame rate drops here and there. I don't think it's so bad that it's distracting or unplayable. But for those who played Elden Ring on PC, Xbox Series X, or PlayStation 5, you're definitely going to notice the frame rate. It's not hitting that smooth 60 frames per second that we saw in those versions. And to be honest, that is a little disappointing."

Bandai Namco hasn't officially confirmed the resolution and frame rate targets for Elden Ring on Switch 2 yet, but so far it looks like the game mostly hits a consistent 30fps in docked mode. While 60fps would make some of the tougher boss fights a little easier to handle--considering just how important timing is in them--having the game run at a cinematic frame rate doesn't make it unplayable. If you don't mind seeing a smaller number of frames per second, you'll still be in for a good time, as the Tarnished Edition on Switch 2 includes both Elden Ring and its critically acclaimed Shadow of the Erdtree expansion.

That's a chunky amount of content for $80, and this version of the game throws in new skins for your steed Torrent, unique in-game armor sets and skins, and two new classes: the Heavy Knight and the Idus Knight. But if you've already played a lot of Elden Ring in the last couple of years, your mileage may vary on the value proposition--plus, you can stick to a version of the game that offers more technical options for enjoying its visuals on PC, PlayStation, and Xbox.

And if the 30fps frame rate is a dealbreaker for you? From Software's The Duskbloods should satisfy that craving for a 60fps souls-like experience when it eventually launches for Switch 2, as early gameplay looks promising .

items.title: Leaker Posts Extended Gameplay From GTA 6 Prologue Just Hours After Rockstar Warns Fans to Expect Story Spoilers
items.summary: Extended gameplay footage revealing Grand Theft Auto 6's story prologue has been posted online, in a significa

content.v: Extended gameplay footage revealing Grand Theft Auto 6's story prologue has been posted online, in a significant escalation of the past week's continued leaks.

More than four minutes of gameplay featuring GTA 6 character Lucia is now being spread over social media, in the first lengthy leak of footage that reveals key story details. If you are planning to try and experience GTA 6 with no narrative spoilers, now is the time to beware where you click online over the coming days and weeks.

The footage's release comes just hours after Rockstar finally broke its silence over the leaks , which it called "heartbreaking" for its development team. In its statement, published online earlier today, the developer warned fans that spoilers would likely impact the manner in which it had hoped players would first experience the game — something that now appears to accurate.

A fresh statement from the leaker, included as a watermark in this latest footage, makes several unsubtantiated claims about GTA 6's development, such as the game still being unfinished and that "too much" work remains on the game to be comfortably completed before the title's November 19 release date.

Earlier today, Rockstar noted that it was indeed still working on the game — something that is fully to be expected with nearly three months left to go until launch — but that it was now "nearly" finished. The company also reiterated GTA 6's November 19 launch date, suggesting confidence that nothing would change.

The leaker has also claimed to have a "recent" build of the game, something that is again impossible to verify. However, there is now little doubt that these leaks stem from a polished playable build. Exactly how the leaker has gained access to it remains a mystery, but one which Rockstar and GTA publisher Take-Two are actively taking steps to ascertain .

Finally, the leaker once again called for "support" in the form of their own cryptocurrency, something that has been widely seen as a money-making exercise . Perhaps signalling that their leaking days may be winding down, the leaker suggested that "trading volume/price" of the $Cyberleek currency would determine whether the posting of footage will continue.

The past week has seen more than a dozen gameplay clips appear online , causing significant damage from a Rockstar perspective as numerous sections of GTA 6's world have now been revealed. According to Bloomberg , Rockstar has been left scrambling to discover how these leaks happened and who is behind them, as they have continued now for the past week.

Former Rockstar Games technical director Obbe Vermeij, however, has downplayed the damage caused by the leaks . Vermeij, who worked at Rockstar North from 1995 to 2009, took to social media to say that the company has weathered worse in the past, such as the Hot Coffee scandal.

Of course, all of this is happening with just a day to go until Rockstar Games' own unveiling of GTA 6 gameplay, via its Grand Theft Auto 6 Extended Look. This lengthy and official debut will be released exclusively on Netflix for six hours, before arriving on other platforms such as YouTube. Find out exactly when the GTA 6 Extended Look will be available where you are right here.
Tom Phillips is IGN's News Editor. You can reach Tom at tom_phillips@ign.com or find him on Bluesky @tomphillipseg.bsky.social

items.title: The Most Expensive Xbox Ever Now Includes Another Special Perk
items.summary: Microsoft has announced that preorders for the 25th-anniversary edition of the Xbox Series X are now open (at

content.v: Microsoft has announced that preorders for the 25th-anniversary edition of the Xbox Series X are now open (at least to some), and if you want one, it's going to cost you.

As rumored, the 1TB console will cost $900, which is $100 more than the standard Xbox Series X. It features a translucent green design and sports an "Xbox 25" logo to celebrate the milestone. The bundle comes with a special-edition 25th-anniversary translucent green Xbox controller as well. Each console unit is individually numbered.
Additionally, Microsoft has announced that all of the 25th anniversary Xbox consoles will include a download code for Halo: Campaign Evolved.

The game launched in July, and while Halo's co-creator had some issues with it , he and others, including us here at GameSpot, generally enjoyed the remake . It's also the first Halo game on PlayStation.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Screenshot-2026-08-26-at-11.21.44-AM.png?w=636

Microsoft is opening up preorders today, August 26, for "some of Xbox's most dedicated fans." Everyone else, meanwhile, can try to get their hands on one starting August 27 at 7 AM PT / 10 AM ET through Xbox or other retailers.
The console will become available, for anyone who secures a preorder, starting November 13. People can only preorder one.
If you just want the controller, preorders are open now for the $80 gamepad . It releases on October 20.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Screenshot-2026-08-26-at-11.20.09-AM.png?w=636

$900 is a lot of money, but it's not actually the most expensive anniversary-themed console we've seen. That record belongs to Sony's PS5 Pro 30th anniversary limited edition bundle, which retailed for a whopping $1,000 in 2024.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/seaofremnants-gameplay-blogroll-1787580343882.jpg

When Sea of Remnants releases next year, it promises a free-to-play role playing experience where you’ll be able to both hit the open water on a variety of swashbuckling turn-based missions and explore land-based missions in the game’s fictional setting of Orbtopia. And now, after the release of a brand-new trailer during gamescom 2026’s Opening Night Live, IGN can exclusively reveal more than 10 minutes of gameplay, which you can see in the player above.

Sea of Remnants is being developed by Joker Studios and published by NetEase Games, who recently recently-announced a closed beta test coming this December. Ahead of Opening Night Live, I sat down with the game’s Creative Director, who goes by the name Alfie, to break down the new gameplay and dive into what secrets await for players when the game comes out in 2027.
Sea of Remnants Creative Director breaks down new exclusive gameplay and the game’s mechanics.
IGN: What specific mechanics or moments in the exclusive gameplay should we be paying the most attention to.

Alfie: There are three elements that I believe are particularly distinctive. First is the game’s roguelike structure. By combining roguelike progression with turn-based combat and dice mechanics, battles become filled with unpredictability and possibility. We also hope players will pay attention to the music as they experience the game. We have put considerable thought into creating distinct musical atmospheres for voyages at sea, exploration across the islands, combat, and many other situations. Finally, each week, players may discover a new crew member within the world of Sea of Remnants. We want each reunion during a Forgotten Voyage to feel like finding one of your companions all over again. At the same time, every additional crew member introduces new team compositions and combinations, making the roguelike loop richer and opening up even more possibilities.
IGN: What is one mechanic or surprise in Sea of Remnants that you think will genuinely catch players off guard?

Alfie: Sea of Remnants is filled with small details and hidden interactions that we hope players will discover for themselves. For example, if you come across an unassuming lounge chair somewhere in the open world, try sitting down. For a moment, you may forget everything else and simply enjoy the peace and quiet. If I had to choose one genuine surprise, however, it would be the opportunity to discover a crew member each week. Sometimes I may be hoping to find Crew Member A, only to encounter Crew Member B instead. That may disrupt my original plan, but it can also open up entirely new possibilities.
IGN: What does the dual ocean and land settings mean for world-building?

Alfie : Creating an ocean-fantasy world has undoubtedly been one of our greatest challenges. The genre is inherently mysterious, and everyone has their own idea of what it might look like. We spent a long time considering how to distinguish our game and build an original, convincing world, which led us to develop an extensive history and mythology to give the setting depth and internal logic.

Our islands, for example, are designed to feel as authentic and believable as possible, supported by details such as a full 24-hour day-and-night cycle. As players explore the islands and towns, we want them to feel that these are real, lived-in places. Within that grounded world, they will also encounter many strange and imaginative elements; but everything exists naturally within the setting and follows its own consistent logic.
IGN: The game operates on a "set sail, explore, collect, return" rhythm. How does Orbtopia function as part of this loop?

Alfie: Orbtopia plays a central role in this loop. The game is divided into two interconnected layers: the ever-changing voyages at sea and Orbtopia, the safe haven of this ocean world. Players repeatedly set sail from the city and return with the spoils of their adventures. The bounty sent back during a voyage can be put to use in Orbtopia to develop your crew, upgrade your ship, and strengthen your overall capabilities. This progression allows you to venture farther, overcome more difficult challenges, and return with even greater rewards on future voyages.
IGN: With the game’s turn-based combat, how players will need to adapt from one run to the next?

Alfie: To support a wide variety of builds, our combat system needed to accommodate a large number of skills and a meaningful degree of randomness. After extensive testing and iteration, we ultimately chose turn-based combat because it allows us to fully express the freedom and variety of the game’s roguelike build system.

We have also integrated roguelike elements directly into the turn-based combat system, including a dice mechanic that can grant characters an additional action. This adds unpredictability to each encounter while creating more opportunities for strategic decision-making and interactions between different mechanics. Once players reach a certain level, some weaker enemies can be defeated through simplified real-time combat instead. This allows players to focus more of their attention on major boss encounters and exploring the wider world.
IGN: How do you strike a balance between roguelike elements and a longer progression system?

Alfie: Voyage-specific builds provide a faster and more dramatic sense of growth within each run, while progression in Orbtopia establishes a lasting foundation. During each voyage, players can shape their team through a variety of build choices, creating powerful combinations and synergies. These choices are varied and flexible, ensuring that every voyage carries an element of uncertainty. However, a team’s performance at sea is also built upon the permanent progression achieved in Orbtopia. If players encounter an especially difficult opponent, they can return to the city to strengthen their characters’ core abilities, better preparing them for future challenges in the wider world.
Sea of Remnants Creative Director confirms the game will feature customization and accommodate various play styles.
IGN: How will the game accommodate different playstyles?

Alfie: Players can follow the main story to explore our major islands at a steady pace. Along the way, they will learn about the characters, discover the nature of this world, and experience the details that make it feel rich and believable. Alternatively, players can embark on the Forgotten Voyage, quickly identify their next objective, and head directly into a new challenge. There are many different ways to experience the game, and players can choose what suits them at any given moment.
IGN: How deep does customization go?

Alfie: We believe emotional attachment develops naturally through repeated voyages and the time players spend refining and mastering each character. Using the same crew member across different classes and builds can produce entirely different combat styles. Discovering those possibilities and making them work creates a sense of accomplishment shared between the player and the character, while also deepening the player’s understanding of that crew member. We are also continuing to expand each character’s story and related content, giving players more opportunities to form lasting connections with their crew beyond combat and progression.

items.title: A Legendary Star Wars Vending Machine Is At The Center Of A Major Conspiracy
items.summary: More than 27 years ago, Star Wars: Episode 1 - The Phantom Menace released in theaters, ushering in a new wave

content.v: More than 27 years ago, Star Wars: Episode 1 - The Phantom Menace released in theaters, ushering in a new wave of fandom for one of the most important media franchises of all time. Since the film's release, one relic has been a constant: the Pepsi vending machine on Mt. Washington in Pittsburgh. It has remained and kept stocked with drinks ever since then, but it appears that has finally changed as part of some bizarre prank or heist.

Below, you can see what the vending machine looks like--or looked like, depending on its fate. The graphics have faded over time but it's still drawing in thirsty customers with its giant Pepsi bottle on the front alongside some pod-racing action.
This week, however, the machine went missing. It was replaced with a pretty hilarious decoy, featuring a very poorly drawn recreation of the original machine's artwork.

Visitors have noticed that the new machine has 10 buttons, while the original only had nine. It's been speculated that influencer Braeden Days may have swiped it, as he has threatened to do so in the past. It's possible the locals or the Pittsburgh Fire Department had something to do with it, as well, as it's located just outside a fire station.
The new artwork has been compared to the infamous 2012 Jesus-painting restoration , though it will be a lot easier to laugh at if the original machine makes a return.
For more Star Wars action, you can check out Star Wars Zero Company beginning August 27. This will be followed by Star Wars: Galactic Racer on October 6.

items.title: Metro 2039 devs say the ongoing war in Ukraine has changed how they write morality: 'The franchise's very nature is getting too close to reality'
items.summary: "Our team has been living in a state of war for the last four and a half years."

others.title: Anti-Cheat Trials

content.v: The Metro series has its roots in war-scarred post-apocalyptia, as such, it grapples with a lot of themes: The indescribable cost of nuclear war, the grim, complicated grey at the heart of humanity, and the cost of human life in a world no longer built to support it.

Which, to those developers who founded the studio in Ukraine and have been under similar duress as their contemporaries at GSC , has become all too real of a prospect. The studio even tragically lost one of its animators , Andrii 'Nizrok' Korzinkin, who fought and died in Russia's ongoing invasion of Ukraine in 2022.

Speaking to Eurogamer 's Dom Peppiatt in an interview concerning the studio's latest game Metro 2039 , executive producer Jon Bloch tells the site: "The previous games were about preventing war; the themes and the morals and all that supported this idea that revolved around 'how do we as humans stop the cycle that we keep finding ourselves in'.

"And when Russia started its full-scale invasion of Ukraine, that brought war to our doorstep. Now, our team has been living in a state of war for the last four and a half years. And that changes things. Significantly."

This manifests for 4A Games as a major shift in how it thinks about morality. Namely, this idea that a post-apocalyptic world has to deal with shades of grey—the 'everyone is the hero of their own story' idea that comes from an imagined world where resources are scarce and everyone's starving.

But faced with the evils of the real world, that's shifted: "in a situation like this, as the story explores what authoritarian regimes do, and what happens when one takes over, and what happens as they grow and take more and more power… there is nothing good about that. There is only evil involved in that.

"And so the grey morality of the past needs to be more defined now. It needs to be more specific and clear. And so our approach needed to change and, therefore, the story needed to change … Now that war is here, we need to talk about the consequences of it. We're not building this based off of literal real-world events, but Metro has always been political and it continues to be that in the lessons and the morals that the game tries to teach."

Co-creative director Pawel Ulmer concurs, telling the site: "we have this chance to show people what can actually happen if the world would stop working on preventing war. And ironically, we're making [a game] in a world which is already dead! But our world - the real world—still has a chance."

"Metro was always about the cult of war, the propaganda, people dying, and the cost of others' ambitions. It didn't become politicalised; it always has been. But what's become uncomfortable is that the franchise's very nature is getting too close to reality."

It's perhaps easy to dismiss the role that any art—not just videogames—has to play in the bluntly horrifying existential circumstances the modern day finds itself in. But given Russia itself tried to spark a boycott of Stalker 2 , a game that nonetheless grew so popular it throttled Ukraine's internet for hours , it's clear that these studios continuing to put their experience into art is vital.

items.title: Micron, the trillion-dollar memory company, refused to replace a crucial drive for current market value until Reddit got mad
items.summary: 'Pushing back actually worked.'

content.v: With the memory crisis only continuing to get worse, a PC gamer's fear right now is likely their memory, storage or GPU borking, and needing to spend an inflated price to replace it. One such Redditor had an external drive die in just one year, and Crucial only offered a refund of the original price they paid, which was a lot less than similar drives go for now. That was until they brought their problems to Reddit.

Over on the PCMR subreddit , user CarefulMeasurement99 shared that they bought a 4 TB Crucial drive a year ago for $200, and when it broke, Crucial offered that original price in a refund. That same drive seems to fetch up to $800 now (thanks, AI).

Crucial originally set up an RMA for the drive in order to pick it up and send it back to the company. The Redditor replied to this saying, "Due to the recent global increase in SSD prices, $199.999 is unfortunately no longer enough to purchase a new 4 TB drive in the current market", and officially requested a direct replacement.
This story gets a tad complicated because Micron announced the closure of the Crucial consumer business late last year, which threw its ability to actually replace the drive into question.

Crucial responded to this request saying, "after reviewing the current inventory situation, we must advise that we do not have any replacement units available for this product" and again stated they could only approve the original refund.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/6GCU4U3CVgesB5hvUHhCyS.jpg
Crucial does clarify in the warranty section of its website , "We understand that replacement costs may be higher today. However, warranty coverage is tied to the original purchase."

An important point to note is that the Redditor buying this drive from Crucial last year meant they didn't buy one from a competitor. In getting a faulty drive, they missed out on getting a fresh one at the lower price they originally paid. Therefore, one would assume that Crucial should cover the replacement, as it sold a drive it believed would last longer than a single year.

When this problem was taken to Reddit, CarefulMeasurement99 was advised to inform Crucial "that a refund was unacceptable" and they "demanded a 4TB equivalent replacement (or alternative), and mentioned that this issue was gaining massive traction here on Reddit."

They also, on Reddit's advice, cited the Magnuson-Moss Warranty Act, which is an act that, among other things, tightened consumer remedies for active warranties. In this case, they seemingly threw in the reference to suggest that they would take some legal action if necessary.
Micron, being one of the big three memory manufacturers, certainly has the cash to spare, and it has profited heavily from the memory crisis that is causing the prices of memory to skyrocket.
Just a few hours after sending this email, Crucial approved a 1-to-1 replacement, confirming it had "limited inventory available to replace the drive with a new one".
Triumphantly returning to the subreddit, CarefulMeasurement99 said: "Holy shit, pushing back actually worked!"

items.title: Xbox’s Disc-To-Digital Program Officially Announced, And It Sounds Pretty Great
items.summary: Microsoft has officially announced a new Xbox feature that lets you digitize your physical game discs. In a bl

content.v: Microsoft has officially announced a new Xbox feature that lets you digitize your physical game discs.

In a blog post , Microsoft revealed a new system that allows players to "bring the benefits of digital to physical discs," with the aim of giving people more flexibility. This disc-to-digital program was leaked a while back .
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Screenshot-2026-08-26-at-10.54.58-AM.png?w=636
Microsoft said "most" Xbox One and Xbox Series X disc-based games will support the new feature. Here's how it works, in Microsoft's own words:

"Players can claim a digital entitlement by inserting a supported disc into an Xbox One or Xbox Series X console and launching the game. Once the entitlement is claimed, you can experience the benefits of digital, including Xbox Play Anywhere and Xbox Cloud Gaming where supported, while your physical disc continues to work exactly as it always has."

Reporter Tom Warren, who originally broke the news of this program, said the entitlement is "tied to the specific disc, and it will move from account to account if you swap the physical game with a friend or log in to a different Xbox profile and try to play a disc-based game."
To boil it down, here's how the disc-to-digital program works, based on that report and what Xbox boss Jason Ronald said during a Gamescom livestream event:

"Thousands" of games will support this new feature, and more will be added over time. "While not every title will be available at launch, this is an important step toward a future where players can have greater confidence that the games they buy remain with them for years to come," Microsoft said.
People in the Xbox Insider program can begin testing this new feature on August 31. It will be made available to everyone else later.
For what it's worth, Microsoft's original pitch for the Xbox One offered something similar , but fans revolted and Microsoft quickly changed course.

The announcement of the disc-to-digital program comes not long after Sony announced that it would end support for physical PlayStation game discs in 2028 . It's expected that Microsoft will stop supporting game discs, too, with its upcoming Project Helix console.

Analyst Daniel Ahmad of Niko Partners said the disc-to-digital program from Xbox is a "nod towards the transition to an all-digital future." Xbox game sales are more than 90% digital today, he said, which is an even higher percentage that PlayStation.

items.title: MSI Stealth 16 AI+ B3W review
items.summary: Hella nice, but hella expensive. Thanks, 2026.

content.v: If there were ever a laptop design to be right "up my alley", as we brits like to say, it would be this one. That's because it makes its sacrifices in exactly the right places to deliver something genuinely portable, sleek, elegant, and satisfying to use both for gaming and work.

The MSI 'Stealth' laptop looks to have been reimagined along these MacBook or Razer Blade-esque lines—and successfully so—featuring a giant touchpad, thin aluminium form factor, subtle upward-facing speakers, and a spacious screen.

It's not just a looker, though, as MSI has crammed an RTX 5080 mobile GPU into it, making for genuine high-end performance. It has, however, had to be power-limited to play nicely with the slim chassis, meaning you're not getting quite the performance you could get out of a chunkier laptop for the same very expensive price or cheaper.
Buy if...

✅ You use your laptop in public: This thing definitely looks the part alongside MacBooks and other such suave devices, with its aluminium frame and giant trackpad. ✅ You use a USB headset: I didn't have any of the audio latency issues I noticed when using USB earphones/headset.
Do not buy if...

❌ You like to game using the laptop speakers: I noticed definite audio latency over the default audio device with this laptop, which can be annoying in shooters, for instance. ❌ You just want raw performance: This laptop looks gorgeous and is very portable for a 16-inch machine, but you can get more high-end horsepower for less if you don't mind something chunkier.
MSI Stealth 16 AI+ B3W Features

RTX 5080 mobile (125 W)

240 Hz

1x 3.5 mm audio (combo), 2x USB-A 3.2 Gen2, 2x Thunderbolt 4, 1x HDMI 2.1, 2.5 Gb Ethernet
Wireless connectivity
Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 6

90 Wh
Dimensions

Price

After powering on the laptop for the first time, I was immediately impressed by how it feels to use. The trackpad doesn't require much force to press but just enough so you're not accidentally pressing it, and it has a very satisfying click. I didn't have many problems with accidentally moving the cursor while typing because of the size of the trackpad, but it did happen occasionally.
'Satisfying' is also the word I'd use to describe the pleasantly tactile chiclet keyboard. This keyboard has four-zone RGB that I set to solid white to match the classy look.
There's also a decent selection of ports on the Stealth, including two Thunderbolt 4, a HDMI, and even an Ethernet port. This, I found to be particularly impressive given the sleek form factor.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/8wAKzuRysXYey4UkU2o8RE.jpg

Sleek, that is, and very shiny thanks to its 240 Hz OLED. It's of the 16:10 variety, too, which is the best kind as it gives you plenty of space for browsing and so on. I'd say 16-inch with a 16:10 aspect ratio is pretty much ideal for a laptop, especially one like this that's also slim and portable. The OLED panel itself is fantastic, too, with plenty of contrast thanks to the true blacks and vibrant colours. And of course the smooth 240 Hz certainly doesn't hurt in those games that can push frame rates up that high.

Specs-wise, this particular version gives you only the choice of the Core Ultra 9 386H for the processor, but you can choose between an RTX 5070, 5070 Ti, or 5080 version. The latter two come with 32 GB of DDR5 RAM, but the RTX 5070 version comes with just 16 GB. All configs except for one 2 TB version comes with 1 TB of storage.

The version I tested has 1 TB of storage, 32 GB of DDR5-5600 memory, and an RTX 5080 mobile. The RTX 5080 here has a big asterisk: it's a nerfed—ie, power-limited—version of the GPU. With a max draw of just 125 W, that's 50 W less juice than you get with a full-fat RTX 5080 mobile like the one in the Lenovo Legion 7i Pro Gen10 , the current best high-performance gaming laptop . That's a sacrifice made to keep things so slim, as is the choice of CPU which sacrifices some top-end compute performance for efficiency.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/L2HzKAzz29ejwqqnTNhWRE.jpg

So far so good, but there is one area that unfortunately rains all over the parade, and that's audio. The problem isn't the sound quality or volume, as things are great in both these respects—clear, punchy (though not as bassy as standalone speakers, of course), and plenty loud.

The problem is latency and glitching, though mainly the former. Initially the speakers would spit every now and then, but that seemed to clear up after using the laptop for a while. I'm not sure why that is, given I had Windows update paused, but whatever the reason, I was glad when it stopped.

The persistent problem was poor audio latency. There is a delay between my in-game action (such as shooting) and the sound coming through. It's about the same level of delay as I experience using Bluetooth earphones without any low-latency mode enabled. It only happens over the default audio device, not when I plug in a new USB device like my earphones with USB-C DAC.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/z6FjWZzDvaeTxbQL6zCJbE.jpg

That leads me to believe it might be a problem with the default audio device drivers, and after checking various ( x ) discussions ( x ) online it seems like the problem could be with Nahimic, however I cannot confirm this. I can say that I tried different methods to disable and uninstall the drivers, which didn't work, and I also uninstalled the Norton antivirus that comes bundled with the laptop just to see if that was the issue, but that didn't resolve it. MSI says it is looking into the issue, but so far I haven't heard any results of this investigation.

To be clear, using the speakers is fine for listening to music and for playing casual, non-shooter games, but for playing shooters the latency is definitely noticeable, meaning a separate USB audio device might be necessary. Though saying that, when testing a different MSI laptop, even switching to a different device didn't resolve the latency, though it strangely did with the Stealth.
MSI Stealth 16 AI+ B3W Performance

Given the high-end components sitting inside this MSI Stealth 16 AI+ B3W, it was never going to fail at churning out frames. You'd have to severely throttle an RTX 5080 laptop GPU for it to be unable to deliver playable performance. But for the Stealth's price tag we want more than just 'playable', so let's see how it does.

items.title: 《队长小翼2 世界群星》简评：借风起势的“格斗”足球续作

content.v: https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/0826/20260826205029-6818-87731.png?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
8月27日，《队长小翼》系列暌违六年的家用主机新作《队长小翼2 世界群星》即将发布。在世界杯年推出这样一款足球题材游戏，时机的选择可谓恰到好处。但真正值得讨论的问题在于：在一代“杀人足球”的基础上，游戏《队长小翼2 世界群星》又能带来怎样的体验？
尽管有些老玩家了解过这个IP，但我在写二代《队长小翼2 世界群星》的评测时，还是要再提一遍：如果用传统足球模拟游戏的标准去衡量《队长小翼2 世界群星》，恐怕会得出“离经叛道”的结论。它几乎放弃了《FIFA》《实况足球》这一类足球模拟游戏所遵循的哲学——战术体系、传切配合、阵型运转，这些在足球运动中被视为核心的内容，在本作中几乎找不到踪影。取而代之的，是一套高度类似动作游戏的攻防玩法。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/0826/20260826205030-8164-97266.png?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
玩家要做的事情很直白：一个人带球、与防守球员一对一博弈、积攒能量、释放必杀技而不是追求角度的射门。每次过人本质上都是一次QTE：对方发动抢断，你需要按盘带躲过；如果对方发动技能，那么你也要发动技能；即便是射门，在耗空守门员的HP（破防）前，你几乎不可能进球，反之防守时也是如此对应。这种策略，与动作游戏讲究的出招与应对一致。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/0826/20260826205029-2868-33183.png?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
制作团队在采访中也坦承，他们极力摒弃了前作中复杂的组合键操作，将大部分基础动作收纳进单一按键，并引入了“精准格挡”和“化招/闪避”机制，让攻防转化变成“完全凭借直觉和时机判断的爽快博弈”。
与前作相比，《队长小翼2 世界群星》在系统上作出了显著调整。
《足球小将：新秀崛起》允许玩家创建多名自定义角色，组建一支完全个人化的“梦之队”。这种设计赋予玩家极高的自由度，但也带来一个问题：肝度过高，你必须不断养成，配卡片升数值，到最后变成了RPG游戏，自创角色的能力过强。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/0826/20260826205030-3960-41845.png?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
《队长小翼2 世界群星》中，自定义角色仅有主角一人，以“新星”的身份加入小翼的队伍，体验以世青篇为基础的原创故事。
在技能获取方面，本作也走向了更简洁的路径。玩家通过与原作角色建立羁绊、完成主线章节剧情来学习招牌动作。相比前作复杂的属性养成和数值培育，本作更接近“学技能、配技能”的模式，玩家需要思考的是你想站在什么位置，想要搭载哪些技能、如何与所在球队的原著角色互补。这种简化降低了上手门槛，但也意味着失去了一部分前作中深度养成的乐趣。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/0826/20260826205032-5032-99445.png?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
本作核心的新机制是Chain Level。当玩家（电脑）成功过人或使用超级动作时，可以累积这个全局等级，以能提升射门威力。这个系统的精妙之处在于：Chain Level是敌我双方共享的。如果对手抢走了球权，他们同样能享受等级带来的增益。这意味着玩家越到比赛后段，越要谨慎，难度越大，局势随时可能逆转。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/0826/20260826205033-2710-83476.png?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
除了Chain Level，本作还加入了“奇迹球队动作”。每支球队都拥有专属的奇迹动作，只要满足特定条件即可发动，带来强力增益甚至直接得分。比如日本队是“全力高空飞跃”可以直接得1分，发动条件是全队消耗一定超级动作量表，且射门被弹飞时；巴西队则是“足球王国的双翼”等。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/0826/20260826205031-6603-91511.png?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
在传统的超级动作（必杀技）方面，本作在射门之外新增了传球、盘带、抢球、格挡等多种类型。几乎所有球员都拥有自己的超级动作。守门员也设有HP条，射门时需要与守门员进行方向博弈——如果射门方向与守门员扑救方向一致，守门员HP消耗大幅减少；反之则遭受近乎全额的射门伤害。这套“破防”机制进一步强化了游戏玩法的猜拳感。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/0826/20260826205032-4918-59291.png?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
剧情模式是本作的核心内容之一。游戏以《足球小将》世青篇为基础，收录了由原著作者高桥阳一亲自监修的原创剧情。玩家扮演的自创角色将与日向小次郎、大空翼等经典角色并肩作战。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/0826/20260826205033-7611-70690.png?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
剧情模式包含多条路线：一开始玩家会从巴西足球联赛开始，加入小翼的队伍，一边拿下州冠军，进而进入日本国家队，代表国家队体验经典世青篇剧情；传奇与挑战者路线则呈现了漫画中未曾描绘的原创故事；此外，比赛中还设有“章节挑战”，完成特定目标后可解锁额外剧情篇章，进而获得更多球场能力。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/0826/20260826205034-3292-58109.png?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
从内容量来看，本作收录了22支国家队、110名可操作球员、超过150种球技。BGM总数超过80首，由前作作曲家牧野忠义继续担纲。预购特典包含日本国家队2026年球衣、世青赛球衣等，这些细节对粉丝而言无疑是加分项。
但客观而言，如果严格从游戏系统和玩法维度来审视，本作在养成深度和自由组队方面相比前作有所削弱。前作中那种“组建个人梦之队”的乐趣被大幅压缩，取而代之的是更聚焦的剧情体验和国家队对抗。对于期待在养成系统上进一步深化的玩家来说，这可能是一个遗憾。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/0826/20260826205034-2103-86087.png?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70

选择在世界杯年发售，固然有“借风起势”的商业考量。它仍旧坚定地走“动作足球”乃至“足球格斗”的路线。用华丽的动画演出、简单的操作逻辑和充满博弈感的对抗系统，试图还原原作漫画中那些令人热血沸腾的瞬间。对于喜欢《足球小将》的粉丝而言，这款游戏无疑是一场情怀盛宴——熟悉的角色、经典的招式、热血的剧情，处处可见对原作的致敬。但对于期待深度战术和复杂养成的玩家来说，它的内容方向可能会让人感到某种程度的“缩水”。这可能也是出于发售档期的考虑。
https://xyoss.g.com.cn/xy-production/cms3.0/2026/0826/20260826205035-7524-18518.png?x-oss-process=image/resize,w_1000,m_lfit/quality,q_70
如果要再给它找一个优点的话，可能就是白金（全成就）难度降低了吧。

items.title: Crazy Taxi: World Tour Has the YA YA YA YA YAs but Stumbles With the “World” Part of World Tour – Gamescom 2026
items.summary: Crazy Taxi: World Tour is an almost refreshingly uncomplicated palette cleanser free of skill trees, crafting

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/25/ctwt-blogroll-1787699531580.jpg
Key Preview Takeaways:

One of the defining games of Sega’s Dreamcast back in the day was the arcade driving game, Crazy Taxi, first released more than a quarter of a century ago. With its fantastic soundtrack and its frenetic driving, it is about as quintessential “early 2000s” as you can get with a video game, and it has been 12 years since the last game released bearing the Crazy Taxi banner and double that since the last console release. Recently, Sega had us out to get a little hands-on time with the brand new entry, Crazy Taxi: World Tour, that was first announced back at Summer Game Fest earlier this summer. With The Offspring screaming YA YA YA YA YA at me, I slammed down the pedal and off I went to pick up my first passenger, mostly happy with what’s here but wishing it did more to put the “world” in “World Tour.”

Revealed just recently at GamesCom was a brand new level making its debut: Germany. The new level has most of those ingredients that you would want from a fast-paced arcade game like Crazy Taxi. I was dropped onto the tarmac of a large airport, a great place to get used to how the cab controls and feels while pulling off some sick donuts. The large size of the hazards also made them easy to avoid… most of the time. Once I was done taking passengers from one side of the airport to the other, it was off to explore the rest of the level.

The region is divided into five areas: the airport where you start, the City, the Walled City, the Mountains, and the Autobahn that connects them all. I’m not entirely sure about how an airport screams “Germany”, but the other areas, especially the city areas, did give off at least a little bit of a Deutschland vibe. One of the niftier additions to World Tour, though, was being able to at any hop into a menu and change the time of day, with my options including being able to pick from morning, afternoon, evening, or night.

Outside of simple visual aesthetics, I didn’t really notice this time shift affecting the gameplay at all, be it the number of passengers that were out, the density of the traffic, or what odd jobs appeared. I also didn’t notice time passing naturally, but that could just be due to having so little time with World Tour. Hopefully in the final game, the sun will rise and set on its own as you drive around, because each time of day featured its own distinct beauty, and I wouldn’t mind the time of day impacting how the areas behaved. Regardless, driving around during the golden hour of evening or while surrounded by the lights of buildings at nighttime was pretty neat.

Speaking of driving, as it’s the pillar that the Crazy Taxi series is built upon,World Tour controlled really well, letting me pull off tight turns, sick boosts off ramps, and quick dodges around oncoming traffic. Acceleration felt right, and managing to utilize the fast break right on cue feels damn good. I’ve always gravitated more towards arcade racers than driving sims, especially those from the era that Crazy Taxi comes from. Where acceleration is fast, there are shortcuts sprinkled all over for you to discover, and mastering its movement and maps almost becomes an art form. I didn’t have enough time to really regain all my cabbie instincts, and my reaction times are a bit slower than when I was in my teens; it still seems to be on the right track to nail what I remember the old games not only feeling like, but hearing like, too.

The moment those first few chords of The Offspring started, though, it was like I hopped in the back seat of Axel’s taxi and was whisked away back to the early 2000s, where I just wanted to turn my brain off and zip around trying to beat my personal best records and listening to sweet tunes. It really makes me smile that the team understands just how closely linked Crazy Taxi is to the music. I associate the “All I want” and its signature YA YA YAs to Crazy Taxi just like I connect Tony Hawk with Goldfinger’s “Superman” track, and to hear it back in World Tour really helps tie it together.

But my time in fictional Germany wasn’t spent just vibing to late ‘90s skate punk and taking passengers to their destinations. Other activities, including various odd jobs and skill tests, were available to check out, giving me a little break when I wanted to take a rest from delivering passengers. These all required me to drive fast, of course, but were usually nice breaks from the typical getting from point A to point B.

During one of these jobs, I had the environmentally crucial task of driving into neatly stacked piles of nearby paper so that the worker in the backseat, equipped with a vacuum, could suck them all up. The one I probably had the most fun with, though, was where I had to slam on my brakes and send a guy in a wingsuit flying, trying to rack up the most distance. At least up until my demo crashed and I had to call it quits (but hey, it’s a pre-release build; it happens).

The whole time I was zooming around picking up fares and boosting off ramps, and even though I was having a fun time doing it, there was a nagging thought in the back of my mind, like a bug buzzing around inside while you're driving – things just looked sort of, well, generic? While the cab itself looks pretty fly, the various other cars on the roads and especially the NPC passengers lacked detail or much personality. Largely coming off as something pulled off an asset store.

The fact that I was driving around what was supposedly Germany, outside of the map telling me, and colorful arched buildings (which, had I not been told, I would have just attributed as “generic European town” I would have just assumed it was a random place. I would love it if Sega leaned into the culture a bit more. Have the passengers speak with a German accent or have the occasional townsperson swap their shorts for some sick Lederhosen. I get that the vast majority of people don’t wander around like that anymore, but taxi drivers don’t have green flames bursting from their tires either. And I’m still trying to figure out what about the airport is supposed to make me feel like I’m in Germany, aside from the occasional sign in what I assume is German alongside the ones that are still in English. Why take me around the world if you aren’t going to represent the people as well as the scenery? This is a game where you drive a taxi; if I’m driving around in Germany, shouldn’t I be picking up German passengers, or at least folks that sound like they’re German?
https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/25/ctwt-blogroll-1787700178546.jpg

Still, even in this early state, as I was drifting and boosting around Germany, I settled into that peaceful, serene sort of state when I could see myself just doing it for hours. The whole loop, while simplistic, was just fun. There is a reason that the Crazy Taxi series is beloved by so many who grew up with it, calling for its return for so long. It has been a series I’ve always checked out from afar, and only occasionally getting behind the wheel myself, but I get it now.

Playing Crazy Taxi: World Tour, even briefly, was just that simple-yet-exciting sort of fun that arcade games excel at, that makes you want to just keep playing. An almost refreshingly uncomplicated palette cleanser free of skill trees, crafting systems, and the other chaff that seems to be in every game you play nowadays. I just hope they manage to make the levels worthy of the “World Tour” moniker this new ride has.

items.title: The Witcher 3’s Remaster Didn’t Leak, And That Made The Reveal “Hit Different,” Dev Says
items.summary: One of the big surprises from Gamescom's Opening Night Live event this week was the announcement of The Witche

content.v: One of the big surprises from Gamescom's Opening Night Live event this week was the announcement of The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered . Everyone was expecting news about The Witcher 3's Songs of the Past expansion, but no almost no one had The Witcher 3 Remastered on their bingo card.

Marcin Momot, the global community and social media director for CD Projekt Red, said on social media that he is "so happy" the remaster did not leak. "Reveals just hit different when they don't leak," he said.

Many people have called on CD Projekt Red over the years to release a remastered version of the 2015 game, but it never happened until now (though CD Projekt Red did update the game significantly over the years). The game's remastered version launches on September 29, setting the stage for the improvements to be baked into the Songs of the Past expansion in 2027.
Among the enhancements is perhaps the most notable update to the game since 2015: the ability to pet the dog .
With more than 65 million copies sold , The Witcher 3 is one of the top 10 best-selling video games of all time .
A new trilogy, spanning The Witcher 4, 5, and 6, will begin in 2028 with the launch of The Witcher 4 . The game shifts the focus to Ciri, instead of Geralt.
In addition to The Witcher 3 Remastered and the new The Witcher trilogy, CD Projekt Red is working on Cyberpunk 2 , a The Witcher multiplayer game , and a game made in partnership with Scopely .

items.title: LEGO Batman: Legacy Of The Dark Knight DLC Trailer Showcases All-New Arkham Mission
items.summary: Launching alongside the Switch 2 release. We've been patiently waiting for LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Kni

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/26/mahem-1787722804956.png

During the gamescom Studio livestream, IGN exclusively revealed the trailer for LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight Deluxe Edition - Mayhem Collection DLC, which features an exciting look at the new story mission starring Harley Quinn and The Joker, the Mayhem Mode, and the Sinister Pack.

LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight's Mayhem Collection DLC will be available to all Deluxe Edition owners for no extra cost on September 18, 2026, which also happens to be the same day the game launches on Nintendo Switch 2.

The big addition in the DLC is that new story mission that stars Harley Quinn and The Joker, which will see the pair working together to "orchestrate a breakout from Arkham Asylum with a going-away party Gotham City won't soon forget."

Harley Quinn will be equipped with her trusty hammer and her Fun Gun loaded with Confetti and Bubblegum, and she'll also be able to summon her beloved hyenas, Bud & Lou. As for The Joker, he'll bring his Paintball Pelter and Boxing Glove to the party alongside a "fast-paced, agile combat style that is focused on speed and mobility." Players will also be able to unlock outfits for Harley Quinn and The Joker that are based on past Batman Media, including The Dark Knight Returns comic book series, Batman: The Animated Series, and more.

Outside of the story, the Mayhem Mode will unleash Harley Quinn and The Joker across Gotham City and task them with time-limited Mayhem Runs. During each run, they will need to make it back to Amusement Mile before time runs out, and they will be chased by Batman and Robin while doing so. You'll earn LEGO studs by smashing everything in sight and completing challenges, alongside battling A.R.G.U.S. Agents and members of Amanda Waller's Task Force X in Deathstroke, Killer Croc, Captain Boomerang, Deadshot, King Shark, Polka-Dot Man, and other "notorious DC Super-Villains."

The Sinister Pack includes themed outfits inspired by popular DC comic book issues and action figures, plus a new vehicle and Batcave customization options. The full list of items this pack includes is as follows:

The last thing that will be added on September 18 will be an enhanced 'Absolute' difficulty level, which will actually be a free update for all players. This new difficulty mode will require "greater skill, awareness, and precision in combat."

LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight released on PS5, Xbox Series X/S, and PC back in May 2026, and in our review, we said, "a strong open-world Gotham and trademark Lego slapstick humour powers a fantastic plastic parody of Batman’s greatest hits."
For more, check out everything announced from Opening Night Live and what else to expect from the rest of gamescom.
Adam Bankhurst is a writer for IGN. You can follow him on X/Twitter @AdamBankhurst, Instagram, and TikTok, and listen to his show, Talking Disney Magic.

据The Verge报道，在今晚的科隆游戏展XBOX发布会上，微软正式公布一项名为“光盘转数字”的全新Xbox功能，玩家可以将自己手中的实体游戏光盘，解锁对应的数字版游戏授权，该功能也被视作微软推进游戏留存、为下一代Xbox主机做准备的重要举措。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608262240175700.jpg
按照官方说明，大部分 Xbox One 与 Xbox Series X 实体光盘都将支持这项能力。玩家只需把兼容光盘插入主机并启动游戏，就可以申领数字授权。值得注意的是这份数字权益是绑定光盘本体，如果把光盘转借、出售给其他人，数字授权也会随之转移到新使用者的账户下。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608262240231606.png
该功能将于 8 月 31 日率先向 Xbox Insider 预览计划的测试人员开放，后续数月内逐步推送给全部 Xbox One、Xbox Series X 用户。成功申领数字版后，如果游戏支持，玩家还能借助 Xbox Play Anywhere 在 PC 端游玩，或是利用 Xbox 云游戏在多设备上串流体验。
报道同时提到，游戏发行商掌握该功能的适配决定权，因此上线初期不会覆盖全部作品。微软表示首发将支持数千款游戏，后续还会持续扩充适配阵容。

items.title: Exterminauts Season Pass Won’t Make You Pay If You’re Willing To Play
items.summary: Dead by Daylight developer Behaviour Interactive is venturing into new live-service territory with the upcomin

content.v: Dead by Daylight developer Behaviour Interactive is venturing into new live-service territory with the upcoming release of Exterminauts , a new third-person shooter that merges the blue-collar energy of Ghostbusters with Starship Troopers. The game is already drawing comparisons to Helldivers 2, and while these are two distinctly different experiences, Behaviour Interactive is taking a page from Arrowhead's book with how it'll give players the opportunity to unlock Battle Passes by simply playing the game--or buying it with cash to support the studio, if you're pressed for time.

"We should be launching with our live content, I think, about a month after [the game's] launch," creative director Vincent Regimbald said to GameSpot at Gamescom . "You're not going to be stuck too long without new content. We'll also announce it ahead of time, so people will know it's coming up. We're going to have some short Warbond-like Battle Passes that are going to be about six weeks long, so the cycle is going to be fairly quick, and payment is purely optional. The in-game currency you'll be able to find, earn, and obtain through daily objectives [and] weekly objectives."

Regimbald added that the Battle Passes will offer new cosmetics and weapons, but generally, these will be obtainable through regular play. Helldivers 2 uses a system where players can find caches of the game's premium currency in each map, but earning enough of it to purchase the new Warbond does require you to commit a substantial number of hours to the game each month.

Mods in Exterminauts can also be earned through this route, and Regimbald said that these will shake up the default performance of weapons, unlocking wild options for players when they experiment with them.

"What they can do is give elemental damage to your shots, offer an instant reload, or give you extra critical damage on your weapon," Regimbald explained. "Sometimes there are combinations with the gadgets that you've been using or the special weapons that you've been using. We think that players will be able to skew their build in a very particular direction depending on the mods that they select.

"There's also what we're calling the emblems and the badges. These are passive abilities that you can put on your character, so they can give you essentially what would look like a character class or playstyle class. You can be much more focused on gadgets, healing, or ice damage, for example. These things will affect your gameplay around that. To give you an example, if you do take the ice-focused emblem, if you freeze enemies and shoot at them, they'll blow up and cause area-of-effect damage. There are combos that you can start to create with the mods, combined with the emblems."

In our own hands-on time with Exterminauts , we found that the use of mods is a nice incentive to get players to stick around for another run or two. The game isn't anything revolutionary, but its lighthearted combat and chaotic co-op could make it worth keeping an eye on. Exterminauts launches in 2027 for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S.

items.title: 育碧草台班子！游戏上线忘记打包文件 仅23KB空壳
items.summary: 育碧于今天在Steam平台推出了初代《魔法门之英雄无敌III》，合集包含《魔法门之英雄无敌Ⅲ》原版及其两部资料片：《末日之刃》与《…

content.v: 由你来说： 育碧把经典游戏重新带上Steam本该是好事，却因上线后仅有23.49KB“空壳”引发大量差评，你觉得这是离谱的发布事故，还是如今大厂“草台班子”现象的又一次体现？
育碧于今天在Steam平台推出了初代《魔法门之英雄无敌III》，合集包含《魔法门之英雄无敌Ⅲ》原版及其两部资料片：《末日之刃》与《死亡阴影》。
然而游戏上线后却出现了一个比功能缺失、兼容性问题更加基础的故障——玩家下载到的游戏文件似乎根本不是完整游戏。
玩家购买后却发现，游戏安装包大小仅有23.49KB。当玩家尝试启动游戏时，还会出现“占位可执行文件”错误。这显然不是正常游戏首发当天应该遇到的问题。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608262204165164.png
23.49KB对于一款完整的PC游戏而言，这个容量根本不可能容纳游戏所需要的地图、美术资源、音频、程序代码以及其他文件。根据目前玩家反馈的情况来看，他们下载到的似乎只是一个占位文件包，而并非真正的游戏本体。
PC玩家早已习惯游戏首发出现各种问题，例如闪退、卡顿、硬件识别错误，或者需要下载一个庞大的首日补丁。但这些问题通常发生在游戏已经安装到玩家电脑之后。而这一次的问题是，游戏本体似乎从一开始就没有正确提供给玩家。对于花费10美元购买游戏的玩家来说，这显然是无法接受的。
与此同时，《魔法门之英雄无敌III》在Steam上迅速获得了大量差评。

items.title: 触乐怪话：斯普拉遁天下第一
items.summary: 触乐怪话，每天胡侃和游戏有关的屁事、鬼事、新鲜事。 蛮颓人讲起道理，谁敢不买（图/小罗） 前一阵任天堂公布最新一季财报，Switch 2发售13个月销量达到了2368万台，这一成绩是非常出色非常厉害的。但国内关于Swit

content.v: http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-26/6a8e3766af5f1.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
触乐怪话，每天胡侃和游戏有关的屁事、鬼事、新鲜事。
前一阵任天堂公布最新一季财报，Switch 2发售13个月销量达到了2368万台，这一成绩是非常出色非常厉害的。但国内关于Switch 2的讨论似乎没有那么“热”，我觉得很多Switch初代玩家都在“观望”。
Switch初代首发的游戏《塞尔达传说：旷野之息》在国内达到了现象级的传播，后来又有《动物森友会》，这两个游戏在国内的影响力远远超过了一般主机游戏，让很多人买了Switch。到了Switch 2，首发游戏阵容非常北美向，对国内玩家来说就没有那么大的吸引力了。
包括我在内，我相信很多玩家都在等一个让自己有理由从Switch初代升级到2的游戏。我一度期待的《密特罗德：究极4 穿越未知》发售后评价平平，让我也没有兴趣立刻换机器（更何况任天堂还没有放弃Switch初代，很多新游戏还能玩）。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-26/2916a8e3a9e73417.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
这一等就是一年多，直到《斯普拉遁：涂击队》公布。
若给Switch上的游戏按照“地位”“创新”这种维度排序，《斯普拉遁》都排不上第一。但要说哪个游戏最讨人喜欢，《斯普拉遁》绝对是我心里的第一。《涂击队》并不是《斯普拉遁3》续作，而是基于3代内容衍生出的单人游戏。PvP被彻底去掉，主打单人刷刷刷。虽然没有正作那么时尚，但熟悉的元素都在，新的鲑鱼敌人也傻憨可爱。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-26/7566a8e3b98c6c0a.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
上个月临近《涂击队》发售，我看到任天堂公布了下半年会在一些地区给Switch 2涨价。考虑到现在AI热潮导致的存储涨价，一两年内应该不会有任何回落的可能。也许久没有享受一把首发游戏当天开玩的乐趣，于是就火速下单了Switch 2，并且预购了数字版《涂击队》。
发售后玩得很开心。《涂击队》去掉PvP的设计我个人是非常喜欢的。毕竟PvP有胜负，饶是《斯普拉遁3》加入了涂地元素，还有抢塔、占地等各种玩法，但被其他玩家击败或被杀终归还是不愉快的。在国内社交媒体上关于《斯普拉遁》各种自制周边、二创的内容远远多于这个PvP游戏实况内容——也说明很多玩家在意的是好看，而不是赢。主打单人的《涂击队》很好地承接了这种需求，游戏是好玩的，难度曲线也是非常友好的。
本来打算先一台机器两个人玩，对象看到社媒上有玩家说《涂击队》如果多人联机刷关，似乎能出更多素材。对于一个刷子游戏来说，这点还是很诱人的。于是我当机立断又下单了一台Switch 2买了一份《涂击队》，和对象双排起来。
多没多素材我不确定，但双排确实比单人玩更有乐趣。放在几年前，可能还会考虑一台主机两个人各自玩，节省一点，现在只会觉得想玩想联机的想法更宝贵一点，趁着最有劲头的时候玩。花开堪折直须折，莫待无花空折枝。
对于游戏主机厂商来说，能带动主机销量的游戏一定是拳头产品，我这两台也为《斯普拉遁》在任天堂社内的地位，增添了两块砖。这个在Wii U时代被主机销量限制的游戏，在Switch上通过2、3两作已经大放异彩。现在Switch 2机能也提升了，销售势头又好，我想《斯普拉遁4》可能真的会“天下第一”。

items.title: 科隆开幕夜上最有班味的射击新游，给PvE赛道带来了新的“卷法”
items.summary: 玩家呼唤PvE游戏，可能从《Left4Dead》开始。但直到现在，“玩家合作通关”的PvE游戏总处于一种间歇性供给不良的处境中。市面上隔三岔五就会出现一款很受欢迎的PvE合作射击游戏，这种趋势已经延伸到更多产品的设计中。

content.v: 玩家呼唤PvE游戏，可能从《Left4Dead》开始。但直到现在，“玩家合作通关”的PvE游戏总处于一种间歇性供给不良的处境中。市面上隔三岔五就会出现一款很受欢迎的PvE合作射击游戏，这种趋势已经延伸到更多产品的设计中。但与之相对，这个品类似乎很难形成持久、稳定和影响力广泛的产品系列。两个成功产品之间往往有那么一段时间的间隔——自《绝地潜兵2》之后，已经有一阵子没有一个影响力足够广泛的PvE射击游戏出现了。
由加拿大Behaviour Interactive研发、国内由腾讯游戏发行的PvE合作射击新游《异克斯小队》（Exterminauts）有可能成为下一个大家欢迎的PvE射击游戏。就在昨晚的科隆游戏展开幕夜（Opening Night Live）上，这款游戏正式首曝，并同步释出了中英两版宣传PV。
首曝PV的宣传语是“打卡！打工！打钱！”——这条宣传语基本能概括游戏的整体氛围：轻松、诙谐，带有一些“打工人”自暴自弃的黑色幽默。这些内容也在PV中得到了展现：最直观的是玩家的“工友”身份，PV中有许多诙谐粗犷的工友对话，角色外观设计也很有劳保特色；然后是看起来十分丰富的天气变化、武器系统和怪物群；游戏整体色彩给人一种“明丽”的感觉，和此前市面上的许多同类产品区别很大。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-26/5856a8ee79ab0a23.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
《异克斯小队》的玩法属于此类产品常见的设计，由大量随机性带来每局地图的变化。也因此，它很容易让人联想到《绝地潜兵2》：不同的地图生态、怪物群和武器系统互相影响，带来每局游戏的不同乐趣。

一个月前，触乐和其他媒体在国内参与了《异克斯小队》的闭门试玩会，并和这款游戏的国服发行团队进行了交流。当时，发行团队非常坦率地告诉我们，他们自立项开始就想做一款大世界的单局合作射击游戏，所以很难绕开产品与《绝地潜兵2》间的比较，他们也并不避讳这种比较。但在这个前提下，他们希望能够通过玩法、合作和任务上的设计，让玩家感受到很多事情是“独属于异克斯小队的”。“让玩家在规则下‘发癫’”，是他们想做的差异化。

在科隆游戏展现场，我和《异克斯小队》的制作团队——包括这款产品的执行制作人Louis-Pierre Pharand、创意总监Vincent Regimbald和高级制作人 Nicolas Joye——进行了采访，这几位制作人都是3A领域的资深开发者，拥有包括《孤岛惊魂 2》《彩虹六号：异种》《刺客信条》等作品的开发经验，你可以想象，这些履历和经验会为《异克斯小队》的战斗设计、世界构建与美术表现构建扎实的基础，也会让这款产品给人的感觉格外闪光。

但在整个交谈过程中，制作团队展现出的最让人印象深刻的同样是一种独属于《异克斯小队》的气质：轻松、愉快。“这个故事的核心其实就是这些‘异克斯小队’的队员们，需要对抗大公司的压力，干活谋生。”Vincent Regimbald对我说，“我们觉得，市面上很多军事题材的游戏都差不多，差不多的人物模版和故事，玩家会有一些很大的目的，要拯救世界……这种游戏让我们玩得有点累了。所以我们想，为什么不做点不一样的？”
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-26/9616a8ee9cd5a1b2.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
■ 为什么要做“轻合作”PvE？
PvE游戏往往能够完美地整合“紧张刺激”和“轻松愉悦”——这也是很多玩家需要它的原因：既能有“枪枪枪游戏”中的战斗反馈和环境压力，又能够在和队友的互相配合、互相陷害和互相拯救中获得安心和快乐感。不过，在此前的大部分时候，这是一个被忽视的市场：在2024年《绝地潜兵2》上线前，很少有人会意识到这款产品会取得如此成功。
腾讯方的发行人员告诉我，《异克斯小队》的投资和立项早在2022年开始。当时他们就决定为PvE潜在的市场做一些准备。“那时候我们的想法是，PvE的市场并不小，只是很多市面上的产品在陷入一些老的思维。”他告诉我，“大家会觉得PvE游戏要提供的是‘射击爽’，但是我们觉得实际上它要提供给玩家们的是在爽的同时，还要有思考和决策的空间。”

如果你问一位标准的PvE游戏玩家对一款PvE游戏的期待，你可能会得到一些“有足够的战术配合感”“射击反馈足够爽””武器和技能要多样化”之类的答案。但实际上，这些回答指向的是一个共同的复合答案：在说这些的时候，PvE玩家们在游戏中想要的其实是一种轻松社交和合作射击共同带来的乐趣——不能太简单，因为太简单则没有相互配合的感觉；也不能太难，因为玩家组队不一定能执行过度复杂的战术，而且太难就玩起来不够快乐了。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-26/8536a8ee9809da57.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
《异克斯小队》尝试从两方面的复合解决这个问题：“太简单”对应玩法深度，“太难”则对应低门槛。它尝试着在大世界的单局合作射击游戏的框架下，让更广泛的用户群体感觉到一种被精心设计过的“合作爽感”：游戏设计了一些通过武器技能组合带来的玩家定位和分工，这些分工有足够的独特性，但又不具备唯一性；与此同时，玩家在低难度下基本不会出现被瞬间秒杀的情况，武器也更加“好用”。
而在内容深度方面，开发组进一步强化战斗武器、怪物群、生态系统之间的复杂性和彼此间的嵌合，从而加强大地图路线和机制上的复玩性。

“轻合作”也是个特殊的尝试，3人小队设定显然是对传统的“4人小队”式结构提出的变化。这种设计似乎想要在合作深度和上手门槛之间找到新的平衡点——3人的奇数不会让玩家再内部分队，也会通过增加每个人要负责内容的来促使玩家合作；游戏依然需要玩家们解决不同的问题，但《异克斯小队》采取的方法更接近于一种问题的增加，玩家的能力很强、可做的事情很多，但是这些要做的事情会被数量影响，你必须和队友“分活”，这种配合感的来源也很有“班味”。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-26/3066a8ee920dce3a.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
■ “工友”们的重工武器战斗
对大部分玩家来说，《异克斯小队》给人的两个突出印象是工友和重工武器战斗。其中，“工友”是整体的叙事基调，重工武器战斗则看起来承担了玩法、手感、战术定位上的丰富性。但实际上，“工友”的叙事决定了《异克斯小队》的整体氛围，包括合作、任务和玩法上，也包括武器。这些内容又反过来进一步塑造了游戏的差异性。
《异克斯小队》的很多地方都很有“工友”的质感。PV中玩家身上橙红色的连体阻燃工装、劳保丁腈手套，高帮钢头靴，还有Overdrive玩法中用钳子（非常有电工感）给武器、炮台充能增强的设计。在后续的研发版本中，玩家也会在游戏中承担更多包括焊接管道在内的任务。
在我看来，这种“工友”质感最重要的地方其实不仅在于这些外观或者任务，更在于无时无刻不在的形象塑造。制作团队告诉我，研发过程中最让他们满意的一个部分是游玩过程中的对话剧本，“这些剧本很有真实的对话质感，也很像现实中的工人，你看不到他们的脸，但是可以通过这些交谈，模糊地知道他们是什么样的人”。

重工武器战斗当然也承接了这些叙事的部分。《异克斯小队》在这一点上的思路非常清晰：几乎所有的武器从外观到功能，都保持了一种很有“工友”感的科幻味。游戏中的很多武器都能从外观、功能和手感让人联想到焊炬喷火枪、凿岩机之类的工友标配。实际上，这些装备也都和世界观紧密结合：玩家的武器来自一些科技公司，通勤依靠星际运输公司，在休息区你会看到这些公司的广告，你需要打工赚钱、购买装备，但你的钱继续流向了那些大公司……
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-26/8896a8ee90c6a5e9.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
把武器做得丰富、夸张、好用并不难，但问题是如何在做到这些的同时，也能让这些武器战斗体验和游戏整体嵌合。重工武器战斗当然非常好玩，而比“好玩”更好的地方在于，它真实地成为了游戏里“打工”逻辑直接落地的工具与劳动方式。
当你能做好这些的时候，游戏自然便会存在一种独特性。我也确实在游玩过程中感受到了这种独特性。我甚至可以预想，在正式上线后，《异克斯小队》里的玩家的合作关系肯定也会很特别——结算时的小抢分会有点“工贼”味，突然来了加班工单时推出一个队友去做，这些东西都会构成那些“只属于异克斯小队”的东西。
■ 长线“打工”的乐趣
在此前的交流中，发行团队告诉我，西方合作射击PvE产品普遍存在更新节奏不稳定的问题，也因此，《异克斯小队》从立项就规划了稳定的长线更新周期。与此同时，游戏的基础系统有每日任务、每周任务，赛季内还有叙事相关的事件，让玩家在一个赛季内每周来都有新的内容体验。
这里的长线运营的底层支撑是大多玩家所熟悉的：怪物会变种，动态天气和地貌变化让每次出勤都有不同。但让我觉得有趣的一点是，在整个交流过程中，制作人和发行团队都告诉我，他们这种变化让玩家不仅限于“战斗”，而是有很多“打工”层面的丰富体验和“有乐趣”，强化玩家的思考和决策。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-26/6476a8ee8dc1effd.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
“我们游戏的玩家目标会和很多同类型产品不同。”Louis-Pierre Pharand对我说，“在《异克斯小队》里，玩家是一个打工人，我们要通过自己的劳作让整个星球的资源流动起来。打工中，我们会尽量地减少死亡带来惩罚，但是你肯定会想拿到更多报酬，做得更轻松。”这种目的决定了玩家的行动路线是接工单、打工、结算、买装备打更好的工……确实很“长线”，也非常贴近现实。
“PvE游戏内容消耗空窗期无法完全避免，但我们的更新模式是通过免费内容更新给玩家新的‘题目’，比如元素相关、配装相关的解题内容，同时不会逼肝，一段时间不玩也不会跟不上进度，随时可以回来跟上节奏。”发行团队对我说，“我们会通过腾讯擅长的运营方式把赛季规划做得更加充实。”
我相信这也是他们所擅长的。更进一步说，从行业的角度，在这次合作中，腾讯或许也可以继续将国内成熟的联机游戏运营体系输送给海外工作室团队，并且在未来形成更加可复用的研发、发行范式，这也是腾讯一贯在做的。
不难看出，《异克斯小队》拥有很多成功的先决条件，研发团队的精良，发行和本地化方面的完备支持。但在这些条件之外，更重要的或许是一颗真的懂玩家的心——腾讯为什么会选择《异克斯小队》？答案可以有很多，比如项目理念和腾讯对合作射击PvE方向上的一致，再比如腾讯一贯的“想把盘子做大”、推动行业玩法进步的思路。
但在现场，用研发团队的话来说，这可能是因为腾讯的工作人员都是一群“真正的玩家”，他们清楚地知道玩家们想要什么，也能和研发团队一起，做出玩家真正想要的游戏。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-26/7326a8ee8bbe0073.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
■ 结语
玩家需要PvE游戏，因为我们需要一些能够在紧张刺激和团队合作上刚刚好的游戏。我们想要刺激，但不想要太大的压力，我们想要和朋友配合，甚至和队友开一些陷害和被陷害的玩笑，但又不想让这些玩笑严重到让整个游戏崩掉的程度——PvE游戏就是那种始终把玩家的心跳维持在一个“比较快，但别过快”的区间里的产品。很多时候，追求这种复合体验要面对的困难可能比很多追求极致的游戏要面对的困难更大。
这可能也是PvE游戏从来都不会“井喷式爆发”的原因，但当有游戏能够满足这种体验时，玩家们的反馈和热情将是巨大的。发行团队告诉我，在此前《异克斯小队》的封闭测试期间，海外玩家的整体反馈高于他们的预期。在调研中，他们发现，得到这种反馈的重要原因之一是很多玩家真的很需要这种游戏，“单局大世界、有一定玩法深度的多人合作射击在市面上比较稀缺”。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-26/9506a8ee88071271.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
而在科隆游戏展现场，我确实也注意到了玩家们的这些需求。在Hall6馆的Level Infinite展区，《异克斯小队》的试玩区，玩家们可以穿着劳保反光马甲试玩游戏——这些画面就像游戏内的氛围一样诙谐，几乎每个我遇到的玩家都会开一些和游戏题材有关的玩笑，他们也都会对我说，这款游戏玩起来真的非常有趣，他们已经迫不及待地和朋友们一起“打工”了。
某种程度上，《异克斯小队》精准切入了一个尚无头部产品占据的“蓝海”位置，可以相信，如果它能够成功，也会为行业带来很多新的方法参考。我期待着这种变化的发生。

items.title: How Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons Is Expanding D&D’s Darkest Corner With New Monsters And Magic
items.summary: The Dungeons & Dragons franchise has continued to evolve over the decades, and in the upcoming Warlock from In

content.v: The Dungeons & Dragons franchise has continued to evolve over the decades, and in the upcoming Warlock from Invoke Studios, players will get the opportunity to explore a darker corner of that popular tabletop fantasy IP. Following its gameplay reveal during Gamescom Opening Night Live , GameSpot had the chance to sit down and chat with Invoke's general manager Dominic Guay and VP Jeff Hattem about the game.

Set beyond the Mists of Darkon, players will make a pact with the warlock Taasha to wield sinister magic, and Invoke Studio says that it was given a surprising amount of freedom to craft the game. "We're building on the franchise, we're expanding it," Guay and Hattem said to GameSpot. "We're going to the Domains of Dread, which is one of the darker fantasy corners of Dungeons & Dragons. And the monster manual is filled with a whole bunch of monsters to choose from, and we're expanding on that as well. The magical spells as well, we're taking what's built into D&D and expanding. We're creating some new stuff as well for players and reimagining some older spells from previous editions."

Compared to the last big D&D game, Baldur's Gate 3 , Warlock gives players more direct control over the protagonist, Kaatri, as it's a third-person single-player adventure. That means no rolls of the dice--just a straight-up dive into action as players wield both magic and melee weapons against the nastier denizens of Darkon.

"D&D is a game that players can express a lot of creativity in, and for me, at least personally, I wanted to make a system that would allow them to express that creativity with magic. The Warlock class has magic at the core of what they can do, and we wanted to really represent that with the game," Guay and Hattem explained. "Being expressive and creative with magic is really fun when you can manipulate the elements, the world, and find an advantage over monsters because of the systems that you can impact."

As for the tone of Warlock? After debuting the gameplay with a trailer that included some Tool music in the background, Invoke says that players can expect a lot more dark fantasy on their journey--as well as some lighter moments, to break things up.

"It is definitely a dark fantasy game, but it's got moments of levity and brightness and color as well," Guay and Hattem said. "We're going into Darkon, which is a huge world, an open world to explore, and it's got a varied biome of elements to explore. There's a whole wide cast of characters that have different personalities and contrasts. Just look at Tasha, she's like very chaotic and exuberant, and then you go into Darkon, there are more dark fantasy characters. So, I think there's a lot, and there's a wide range of tones, I would say, for players. It's not just one note."

Warlock is also aiming to be both an entry point into the world of D&D and appealing to veterans of the series. Invoke explained that Khatri is well-positioned to be a point-of-view character for players to become familiar with DnD, while veterans will easily spot Easter eggs and references throughout the game.

"I think like if you want a fully realized adventure that you can play in the setting of DnD, and see some of the spells that you really like, some of the monsters that you're familiar with, realized into an action-adventure, this is the game for you," Guay and Hattem concluded.
Set to release in 2027, the game features the voices of Tricia Helfer (Battlestar Galactica) as Kaatri and Maggie Robertson, who previously played Orin the Red in Baldur's Gate 3.

items.title: 140万粉丝网红提前看《GTA6》：将公布独家内容！
items.summary: 意大利知名游戏网红MikeShowSha近日宣布，自己此前已经受邀前往Rockstar North工作室，提前体验《GTA6》的Hands-off预览活动。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608262145296695.png
意大利知名游戏网红MikeShowSha近日宣布，自己此前已经受邀前往Rockstar North工作室，提前体验《GTA6》的Hands-off预览活动。
所谓Hands-off预览，是指受邀者无法亲自上手操作游戏，而是由开发团队进行现场演示，受邀者可以观看游戏内容并了解相关信息。
MikeShowSha在社交媒体上发文表示：秘密揭晓！今年7月，我前往Rockstar North工作室，提前了解了《GTA6》
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608262145107542.png
他宣布将于8月27日21:00：YouTube直播，将带来《GTA6》预告独家细节；8月29日13:15：发布YouTube视频，分享关于《GTA6》的一切。
最后他还表示：感谢RockstarGames的邀请，这次经历太不可思议了。直到现在我都不敢相信。已经迫不及待想把一切告诉大家了！
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608262146018395.png
目前，MikeShowSha并未公开此次闭门预览的具体内容，因此他究竟掌握了哪些新消息，还有待后续直播和视频揭晓。

items.title: Lord Of The Rings’ Pippin Actor Just Showed Up In A Video Game In An Unexpected Way
items.summary: As part of Gamescom this week, it was announced that The Lord of the Rings actor Billy Boyd will show up in a

content.v: As part of Gamescom this week, it was announced that The Lord of the Rings actor Billy Boyd will show up in a new game, or at least his voice will.

Boyd, who played the "Fool of a Took" Peregrin Took AKA Pippin in Peter Jackson's The Lord of the Rings trilogy, is playing Robert C. MacBrushy in There Are No Ghosts at the Grand. If you're just catching up, this is a musical mystery game where players inherit a crumbling English hotel. By day, they work to restore it. By night, they deal with the ghosts haunting it.

"Each mysterious character you meet or choose to help has their own story and song waiting to be uncovered. From spooky ska to wartime jazz to skater punk, each song is uniquely theirs… and sometimes surprisingly so," reads a line from the game's description.

Boyd is an accomplished musician himself and fronts the band Beecake. Other performers featured in There Are No Ghosts at the Grand include Alex Brightman, who is known for his Tony-nominated performances in the stage plays for Beetlejuice and School of Rock.
There Are No Ghosts at the Grand releases later this year, and a free demo is available now on Steam .

items.title: 资产估值达14亿美元！詹姆斯成NBA首位现役亿万富翁
items.summary: 勒布朗·詹姆斯成为NBA历史上首位现役亿万富翁

content.v: 据福布斯统计，勒布朗·詹姆斯成为NBA历史上首位现役亿万富翁，2026年净资产估值已达14亿美元，而乔丹、科比等传奇球星都是在退役后才跨过这一门槛。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260826_zy_red_164_21/177.jpg
詹姆斯在2022年正式突破10亿美元身家，是NBA历史上第一位在打球期间就达成此成就的球员，打破了乔丹退役20年后才实现的财富纪录。截至2026年，福布斯对詹姆斯的最新估值为14亿美元，在全球名人亿万富翁中排名第14位。
詹姆斯生涯总薪资超5.8亿美元，但这仅占总财富的一小部分，场外收入常年是薪资的数倍，2026年场外收入占总收入比重已达62%。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260826_zy_red_164_21/1257.jpg
2015年签下价值超10亿美元的终身合约，是耐克史上首份球星终身合约，即便退役后每年仍有约3200万美元保底收入。早年放弃Beats耳机的现金代言换取股权，苹果30亿美元收购时直接套现约3000万美元。名下还有SpringHill传媒公司（估值7.25亿美元）、芬威体育集团股权（间接持有利物浦等球队）、Blaze Pizza披萨连锁等构成商业帝国。

items.title: 国行PS5 Pro秒没！硬件成本大涨 《GTA6》推波助澜
items.summary: 除了芯片重要部件短缺以外，《GTA6》也是这波疯抢潮的催化剂，主机缺货涨价不全是索尼的锅，但官方几乎不给任何补货预期和产能说明…

content.v: 编辑观点： 除了芯片重要部件短缺以外，《GTA6》也是这波疯抢潮的催化剂，主机缺货涨价不全是索尼的锅，但官方几乎不给任何补货预期和产能说明，才是让玩家最焦虑的地方，越临近发售日只会越难买。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608262143018118.png
刚刚结束的一轮国行PS5 Pro官方补货，再度上演了上架瞬间被一扫而空的局面。PlayStation京东官方旗舰店放出的现货库存转瞬清零，页面迅速切回缺货预约状态，不少蹲守许久的玩家连下单页面都没能刷出来。二手与第三方渠道的现货报价依旧居高不下，一机难求的现状，已经成为近期主机圈绕不开的热议话题。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608262143094507.png

造成PS5 Pro供货紧张的根源，来自整个电子行业的供应链压力。芯片、存储等核心零部件持续紧缺，直接推高整机硬件成本，产能释放本身就受到客观条件的制约。而11月《GTA6》的即将发售，相当于给本就紧绷的市场再添一把火。作为本年度最受期待的重磅3A大作，大量玩家计划借着新作上线完成主机换代，不少还在使用普通版PS5的用户，都把PS5 Pro视作运行《GTA6》的最优选择。大作的热度进一步放大了市场需求，进一步加剧现货的争抢。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608262143187269.png
也正是在这样的大环境之下，玩家群体撕裂成两种截然不同的声音。一部分玩家认为距离《GTA6》发售窗口越来越近，如果继续观望，后续现货只会更加稀缺，宁可接受当前的价格也要尽早拿下主机，做到早买早享受。另一部分 “等等党” 则坚持认为，现在第三方渠道溢价水分过大，盲目高价入手很不划算，希望索尼尽快提升产能，等待行情回落再出手。“现在到底要不要硬冲现货”，已经成为很多玩家反复纠结的难题。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608262143256764.jpg
可摆在所有消费者面前的现实问题是，索尼至今没有给出明确的产能说明，也没有公开下一轮大规模补货的大致时间节点。官方只是不定期零星放出少量库存，玩家只能被动蹲守抢购，没有任何可以参考的预期。这种信息的缺失，进一步放大了市场焦虑，不少玩家担心，随着《GTA6》发售日不断逼近，换机需求集中爆发，后续抢机的竞争只会变得更加激烈。
未来PS5 Pro价格和产量能稳定吗？欢迎在评论区分享你的看法。

others.title: Star Wars Zero Company Review
《Star Wars Zero Company》评测

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260826/RjJDRsbuaFgipBx.jpg

Star Wars Zero Company 是由 幽浮 2 开发者（现就职于 Bitreactor）与 星球大战绝地：幸存者 开发者（就职于 Respawn）合作的结晶，这非常合情合理。这两款优秀的游戏虽然截然不同，但它们的优点在这里汇聚，创造出一款画面精美、构思巧妙的策略游戏，同时也讲述了自《侠盗一号》以来我们见过的最出色的星战故事之一。出色的角色、剧本、音乐和电影化风格，为一个以多元雇佣兵团体为中心的战役注入了背景和分量。在这里，原力感应和光剑退居二线，爆能枪和热能榴弹成为了主角，令人耳目一新。虽然其回合制玩法对于像我这样的 幽浮:奇美拉战队 老兵来说非常熟悉，但其更具侵略性的玩法和灵活的角色设计使其远不止是一个简单的星战换皮游戏。
幽浮 2
其他, 策略, 半Q版, 2.5D, 即时, 单人, 多人, 跨平台联机游戏, 一次性付费
查看更多 立即下载

开场动画展示了共和国和分离主义舰队在轨道上交火，镜头随后推向地面上与战斗机器人作战的克隆人士兵，但紧接着转向一侧，聚焦于一场规模较小的冲突。这有效地确立了故事背景：它发生在克隆战争的边缘，而非前线。我们自定义的主角 Hawks 曾是一名军事指挥官，在遭遇失败后与一群边缘人组建了自己的团队。（如果这听起来很耳熟，可能是因为它完美契合了《萤火虫》中马尔科姆·雷诺兹的设定，Hawks 的配音有时甚至带着一点太空牛仔的腔调——但这很公平，毕竟马尔科姆这个角色本身就借鉴了韩·索罗。）

Hawks 一行人立即与名为“无尽螺旋”（Infinite Coil）的分离主义教派产生了冲突。该教派由神秘的 Fathom 领导，她一心想利用令人毛骨悚然的虫子在银河系传播一种改变心灵的瘟疫。虽然有暗示这种疾病可能与原力有关，但面对一个比千篇一律的西斯式反派更有新意的对手，这种节奏变化非常受欢迎。幸运的是，Fathom 在其令人胆寒的表演中保持了神秘感，而她与心腹儿子的关系也防止了她沦为平面化的反派。尽管空间站并非可玩区域，但她最终策划了一场我们在以往星战作品中从未见过的巅峰太空大战。

你的主要船员也都有引人入胜的故事，让人联想到 星球大战：旧共和国武士™™II：西斯领主™（尽管这并不是那种类型的 RPG，你也很少需要做出对话抉择）。虽然角色设定谈不上新颖，但扎实的剧本和表演弥补了这一点：大块头蓝皮肤战士 Kabb 扮演了说话有趣的异形角色；Jae 出身于被“螺旋”驱逐的采矿家族；Trick 是一名因伤退役的克隆人，拥有众多兄弟的支援；Cly 是寻求复仇的曼达洛人；Tel-Rea 是调查“螺旋”的脱岗学徒；而 Luco 则是恨共和国但更恨 Fathom 的神枪手。每个人都有自己的故事任务链，其中包含不少反转以及其他克隆战争时期角色的客串。
你的主要船员也都有引人入胜的故事。

不过，最让我印象深刻的个性角色是你在基地（一艘名为“巢穴”的停泊货轮）互动的非战斗人员。Runa 是你的的人事经理兼会计，她的分离主义背景使她与倾向共和国的其他船员区分开来。由于她讨喜的虚荣心和毒舌属性，她也是最幽默的角色。当你通过全息投影桌选择任务时，她与年轻、循规蹈矩的共和国情报官员 Bennic 之间的斗嘴总是很有趣，随着 Bennic 的忠诚在战争中受到考验，她也让这个角色变得更令人同情。特别值得一提的是医疗机器人 M-3VO 和身材高大的拉斯族军火商 Neesh，他们都有一些精彩的台词。

在进入战斗之前，你还会执行“行动”（Operations）。在这里，你需要花费有限的情报点来选择派遣团队进行的文字冒险，从而解锁更多任务并赚取现金和战利品。其中很多任务感觉就像在盲目掷骰子，因为系统要求你选择派出的团队成员，却没有指示谁更适合执行诸如营救人质或黑入分离主义设施之类的任务——所以当事情出错、人员受伤时，感觉就像错失了一个 90% 命中率的射击。不过我的名单上总是有几个备用人选，所以这从未难倒我。其中一些任务涉及有趣的抉择，会预先展示如果你为了额外积分把某人卖给赫特人，团队中哪些人会感到愤怒。
别跟我提胜算

在你选择任务并观看了重复且不可跳过的过场动画后（在 PC 和 PS5 Pro 上都有卡顿现象），如果玩过 幽浮:奇美拉战队 系列作品，你会发现本作的战术战斗非常容易上手。虽然控制四人小队、寻找掩体、排布攻击以及祈祷随机数神灵保佑命中率的基础机制很相似，但 Star Wars Zero Company 是一款截然不同的游戏，它鼓励你冲入敌阵并击退敌人。你经常会将敌人撞向彼此、撞下悬崖、撞入队友的监视射击区，或者将他们排成一排进行范围攻击。（只需记住永远要有备用计划，因为你仍然会有 10% 的概率错失那些 90% 命中率的射击。）

我之所以感到被鼓励去那样做，很大程度上是因为即使默认开启了永久死亡，你的部队也很难被彻底杀死。一个角色必须倒地三次（且任务间隙未进行治疗）才会永久消失。游戏中也没有多少突袭，因为地图通常很小且没有战争迷雾，这意味着你永远不会被看不见的敌人伏击。最重要的是，在某人第一次倒地受伤之前，承受伤害不会产生持久后果。因此，如果能获得清晰的射击角度，或者足够接近撤离点以便下一回合撤离，我会放心地让部队离开掩体暴露在空旷地带承受一些伤害。尽管这种打法很激进，但在我首次 35 小时的普通难度通关过程中，我几乎没有失去任何人（不过我有数千小时的 幽浮:奇美拉战队 经验，所以情况因人而异）。

另一个主要区别是，它很容易将动作串联起来，让你的操作员在单回合内获得超过默认 3 点行动点的移动机会。每次伤害敌人（或使用特定技能）都会积累优势点，然后你可以将这些点数用于任何角色的额外能力，例如 Trick 的火箭发射器或 Hawks 为队友提供额外行动点的能力。这类能力有很多，这给了你充分的理由为部分队员装备爆能手枪：虽然它们的伤害和射程不如步枪、连发枪或狙击步枪，但每回合可以射击三次（或更多）以快速积累优势。
最难掌握的系统之一是每回合在小队中随机轮换的“后援”（Backup）能力。拥有该能力的队员可以指定范围内的一名队友进行协助，在下一次攻击时，该队友会进行补射，且补射必定命中，即使第一枪打偏了也是如此。每回合都有机会造成保底伤害是非常宝贵的。但你必须深思熟虑，因为如果你的后援队员没有敌人的视线，或者你直接打出暴击击杀了目标，这个机会就很轻易地被浪费了。

尽管击倒数十个倒霉的战斗机器人并看着它们碎成零件很有趣，但 Star Wars Zero Company 在敌人多样性方面本可以做得更好。公平地说，游戏中的敌人类型不少，包括让你在击杀时必须考虑距离的“螺旋”士兵，因为他们的盟友可能会吸收部分能量。有近战兵、狙击手以及介于两者之间的各种兵种，但你遇到的非人型敌人几乎只有滚动的、带护盾的毁灭者机器人（Droideka）。那些战斗令人难忘，但一段时间后，即使你需要调整战术，其他一切也开始变得有些千篇一律。
我在任务中确实看到了不少图形 Bug，但没有什么是能明显干扰到我的。

许多故事任务都非常出彩，部分原因是它们会加入一些机制，比如炸掉你身后的区域逼迫你前进，或者让你同时守住两个地点并在敌人不断刷新时撤离。在某些任务中，你会在同一个地点进行一系列战斗，Star Wars Zero Company 有一个很酷的技巧将它们串联起来：镜头会拉近到第三人称，你可以直接控制 Hawks 从一个战斗区域跑到下一个。这比侧向任务更有真实感，在侧向任务中，你往往会突兀地直接进入战斗。我确实希望在那种视角下能有更多可做的事情，而不仅仅是走向某人或某物并按下按钮触发对话，因为你走过的关卡设计得非常棒。

即便如此，你在任务中可能会遇到不少图形 Bug，尤其是在敌人空降时；当镜头拉近到华丽的动画效果时，镜头可能会变得不自然，甚至让你近距离看一堵墙。有几次在慢动作监视反应射击后，我以为必须强制退出，因为画面卡住了整整 20 秒才恢复。但我还没遇到过任何明显干扰游戏进程的问题——我从未因为 Bug 导致计划落空而被迫重装任务。因此可以肯定地说，Star Wars Zero Company 的 Bug 明显比 幽浮 2 刚发布时（甚至可能比现在）要少。

角色成长系统有点奇怪，因为你可以随心所欲地重塑大部分团队成员。例如，Hawks 可以在一个任务中担任医疗兵，下一个任务变成狙击手，之后还可以切换到其他六个专精。你可以重置他所有的技能点并更换武器（一个非常硬核的细节是，四种武器类型中的每一种都有多种不同的外观可供选择，且带有各自的音效）来进一步自定义玩法。许多可招募的小型角色也是如此——除了极其便利的宇航技工机器人，它们是专门为队友提供行动点、投掷手雷和医疗物品而设计的。这种灵活性确实鼓励了实验性玩法，尽管它让长期团队建设的选择显得不那么重要。

唯一的限制在于你的主要船员，虽然他们也可以重置技能，但每个人都有固定的职业和独特的能力，这给了你保护他们存活的理由（除了能完成他们的故事任务外）。Jae 的“最后一击”会在敌人生命值低于一定阈值时触发极具帮助的处决；Kabb 的近战攻击如果击杀目标会返还行动点；Cly 拥有曼达洛喷气背包，可以在着陆时点燃敌人；Trick 每场任务可以复活自己一次，等等。Tel-Rea 自然也有她独特的杰基技能系统。
唯一无法随意重做的是羁绊奖励。当两名队友关系紧密时，他们的羁绊等级会提升，你可以从三个随机选择的奖励中做出抉择，这些奖励适用于双方，例如增加远程伤害或在首个动作中移动得更远。这些提升本身很小，但随着时间的推移会积少成多，如果你保持选择的一致性，将显著增加一些关键统计数据。
当你解锁为每个角色提供副职业的能力时，情况变得更加复杂。这允许你将技能点分配到两个职业树中，或者专注于其中一个。这为协同能力、武器模组和实用道具开辟了全新的层次。我觉得在第一次通关时我只触及了这种潜力的皮毛，我已经开始尝试困难难度，看看需要如何精细调整加点才能生存。
在第二次尝试的几个小时里，我已经感觉到 Star Wars Zero Company 的重玩价值相对于 幽浮 2 来说有些受限，因为它更侧重于故事，且缺乏让 幽浮 2 充满动态变化的随机生成地图和随机升级解锁。不过，这是一个极高的标准，所以我不会因此苛责它——而且我肯定错过了一些在第一次通关时可能过期的任务，所以我期待这次会有不少新发现。

今日，FromSoftware官方发布公告，将于北京时间8月27日（周四）17点‑20点开展《艾尔登法环》服务器维护。维护期间游戏线上联机服务将暂时关闭，但玩家仍可正常体验离线单机内容。

items.title: 足足30项改进！《巫师3RE》更新盘点：支持PS5 Pro
items.summary: 《巫师3：狂猎》重制版的突然公布让不少玩家已经开始考虑再来一轮冒险。不过，这次强化重制版究竟加入了哪些内容？

content.v: 《巫师3：狂猎》重制版的突然公布让不少玩家已经开始考虑再来一轮冒险。不过，这次强化重制版究竟加入了哪些内容？
外媒Push Square对官方预告片中滚动出现的改进列表进行了整理。由于预告片本身已经展示了完整清单，只需要暂停视频逐项查看即可。以下为Push Square汇总的全部改进内容。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608262117489419.png
此次重制版的大部分升级集中在画面表现上。从官方公布的信息来看，CD Projekt Red似乎对游戏的光照系统进行了较大幅度调整，同时也提升了模型与纹理的细节和清晰度。除了画面升级之外，重制版还加入了一些颇为值得关注的玩法调整。
重制版改进内容：
画面升级：视觉效果全面强化，包括大幅改进光照和纹理表现。
战斗系统强化：进一步优化战斗体验。
移动与探索优化：提升角色移动与探索体验，跳跃、攀爬等动作动画更加流畅。
全新法印特效：使用法印时拥有更加细致的视觉效果。
坐骑操控重制：重新调整骑乘手感，骑马疾驰时对萝卜的控制更加灵活。
怪物行为强化：改善怪物AI，例如预告中展示的狮鹫能够进行格挡并随后发动反击。
技能树重制：技能升级系统重新设计，以相互连接的技能树分支呈现。
装备幻化：可以改变护甲外观，同时不会影响装备原本的属性。
拍照模式扩展：增加更多照片模式功能。
新增终结技：战斗中加入新的处决动画。
跨平台MOD支持：此前官方已经承诺过相关功能。
沉浸式冥想：冥想现在会加入实际的游戏内动画，通过画面展示时间流逝。
动画优化：进一步完善角色动画表现。
全新任务追踪系统：优化任务管理和追踪体验。
UI界面优化：重新调整用户界面。
战利品系统重做：重新调整随机战利品机制及相关系统。
动态模糊优化：改善动态模糊效果。
新增无障碍功能：加入更多辅助功能。
纹理升级：进一步提高纹理质量。
植被阴影重制：重新调整植被的阴影表现。
教程现代化：优化新手教程体验。
HDR效果改进：提升高动态范围画面表现。
GTAO：加入GTAO环境光遮蔽技术，以实现更加真实的阴影效果。
菜单导航优化：改善菜单操作与浏览体验。
光线追踪优化：进一步提升光追效果。
全局光照重制：重新调整全局光照系统。
全新阴影模型：采用新的阴影渲染模型。
次表面散射：增强特定材质的光照表现。
全新色调映射器：改善整体画面的色彩和明暗表现。
支持PS5 Pro：针对PS5 Pro进行优化。
《巫师3：狂猎》重制版将于9月29日推出，预计CD Projekt Red还会在正式上线前公布更多细节，尤其是“PS5 Pro支持”究竟会带来哪些具体提升，目前仍值得关注。

items.title: Witcher 3 Songs Of The Past Expansion Fixes A Major Issue With The Original Game
items.summary: CD Projekt Red has shared new footage and disclosed more details about The Witcher 3's upcoming Songs of the P

others.title: 10.1.0 | Chorus of Sin

content.v: https://i.17173cdn.com/gdthue/YWxqaGBf/kidhub/20260826/nIxTMbbuaDsxleE.png
《巫师 3：狂猎 Songs of the Past》在 2026 年科隆游戏展开幕之夜直播（ONL）上正式公布了预告片，开发商 CD Projekt Red 现场介绍了全新的锁链武器、Letten 领地以及更多细节。
巫师 3：狂猎
魔幻, 角色扮演, 半写实, 即时, 单人, 完全支持控制器, 一次性付费
这是一次卓有成效和大有诚意的更新，足以提升一把我们对CD Projekt跌落的好感值。我得说，我很羡慕那些第一次体验《巫师 3》就是这一版本游戏的玩家，它是迄今为止体验《巫师 3》的最佳版本。
查看更多 立即下载
利维亚的杰洛特助力了 2026 年 ONL 的压轴环节，工作室讨论了计划如何在明年为这款备受赞誉的 2015 年角色扮演游戏推出新内容。虽然仍有许多细节尚未公开，但这次首秀终于向玩家展示了在《巫师4 3》首发 12 年后重返该作的体验。
我们将深入探讨 CD Projekt Red 分享的所有细节，但首先，展会为观众准备了另一个惊喜：一段预告片。你可以在下方查看《巫师4 3 Songs of the Past》的首支先导预告。
锁链出击
那么，首支《Songs of the Past》预告片告诉了我们什么？遗憾的是，乍看之下内容并不多。杰洛特首先出现在一棵挂满灯笼的树前，随后在营地里与一位可能并不存在的伴侣跳舞。接着，我们看到了 Letten 洒满月光的星空和阳光普照的田野，这也是《Songs of the Past》故事发生的全新领地。
杰洛特将面临一系列全新的人类和怪物敌人，虽然这对于一位猎魔人来说并不新鲜，但整个预告片中不断低语的强大反派可能是个新威胁。然而，最让《巫师4 3》粉丝感到兴奋的，可能是视频末尾出现的武器。短短几秒钟的画面展示了杰洛特使用锁链抓取并控制敌人，随后将其斩首。这看起来像是直接从《真人快打11》的蝎子手中夺过来的，而且似乎非常契合猎魔人的武器库。
真人快打11
暴力, 血腥, 动作, 格斗
查看更多 立即下载
欢迎来到 Letten
该资料片的官方描述揭示了 Letten 的景象及其与新故事的联系：“这片田园诗般的土地拥有丰富的乡村传统和民俗，那里的人们过着丰收与奢华节日的充实生活。但在表面之下隐藏着一个黑暗的秘密，杰洛特在努力战胜长期蛰伏的邪恶时，必须克服前所未见的敌人。”
正如展会期间所透露的，粉丝们可以在《Songs of the Past》最终发布前正式将其加入愿望单。CD Projekt Red 表示，新内容将带领玩家前往新的 Letten 领地，尽管目前我们看到的只有预告片中的寥寥数瞥。
CD Projekt Red 谈重返《巫师4 3》
在等待《Songs of the Past》明年发布的过程中，《巫师4》系列游戏和原著的粉丝肯定能从中挖掘出大量细节，但 CD Projekt Red 并不打算止步于此。关卡设计主管 Miles Tost 登上科隆 ONL 舞台，分享了更多关于该扩展包如何基于原版游戏构建的细节。
“这非常酷，”Tost 笑着说，“一段时间以来，我们一直有为杰洛特再创作一个故事的想法，但一直没能确定如何将其排入我们繁忙的日程。幸运的是，我们的朋友 Fool's Theory 伸出了援手，他们聘请了一群《巫师4 3》的老牌资深开发者——包括我的导师 Peter Gelenscer——于是就有了今天的成果。”
Tost 指出，这是《巫师4 3》主角的最后一次冒险，之后希里将在 2028 年左右的《巫师4 4》中接过火炬。给杰洛特配备锁链将使他在《Songs of the Past》中的旅程变得格外令人难忘。
“这种锁链是游戏中的新武器，但许多人，也许是资深的《巫师4》粉丝，会意识到这是我们在《巫师4 1》开场动画中首次展示过的武器，”Tost 继续说道，并引导粉丝前往科隆游戏展的 CD Projekt Red 展台了解更多信息。
Tost 还分享了关于 Letten 以及该环境将如何为粉丝带来改变的看法：“Letten 是一个全新的、独特的区域，拥有独特的身份标识，就像游戏中的其他区域一样。它充满了任务、新怪物、冒险和探索——正如《巫师4》粉丝所热爱的那样。但这是一个近乎诡异的田园诗般的地方，然而，在表面之下隐藏着一个黑暗的秘密，既然这是一款《巫师4》游戏，这种秘密就需要一位真正的专业猎魔人来解决。”
杰洛特终于回来了。《巫师4 3 Songs of the Past》虽然尚未公布确切发售日期，但预计将于 2027 年在 PC、Nintendo Switch 2、PlayStation 5 和 Xbox Series X|S 平台上发布。与此同时，玩家还可以期待在 2026 年科隆 ONL 期间宣布的《巫师 3：狂猎 Remastered》。
我们有望在未来几个月内了解更多关于这个惊喜扩展包的信息。同时，开发者最近也确认该插件将为游戏带来更多《巫师之昆特牌》内容。
