items.title: RX 9070 XT玩《Apex英雄》就崩溃 官方正在调查
items.summary: 最近，《Apex英雄》曝出和AMD显卡Radeon RX 9070 XT存在“不兼容”问题。《Apex英雄》官方账号ApexCommunityJP在X上发布消息：“我们已确认使用AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT

content.v: 最近，《 Apex英雄 》曝出和AMD显卡Radeon RX 9070 XT存在“不兼容”问题。
《Apex英雄》官方账号ApexCommunityJP在X上发布消息：“我们已确认使用AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT显卡的玩家会遇到游戏崩溃的问题，目前正在调查原因。”
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260826/1787748735_786142.jpg
外媒PC Gamer使用配备RX 9070 XT显卡电脑尝试启动《Apex英雄》时，游戏确实会崩溃。收到游戏/引擎“致命错误”：“由于应用程序发送的命令格式错误，应用程序的设备出现故障。这是一个设计时问题，应该进行调查并修复。”
《Apex英雄》官推建议玩家尝试回滚AMD显卡驱动程序，但是，一些玩家似乎早就试过了，但没有解决问题。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260826/1787748674_771578_jpg_r.jpg
不过，在社交媒体的回复中有一个建议似乎有效，那就是在游戏的Steam启动选项中添加以下内容：“+staticprop_color_use_bindless 0 +staticprop_depth_use_bindless 0 +r_drawworld_depth_bindless 0”。
具体操作方法是，在游戏的Steam页面上，点击齿轮图标，然后点击“属性”，再将这些命令粘贴到启动选项中。
这些选项似乎与无绑定渲染有关，无绑定渲染是指GPU直接访问着色器而无需CPU介入。这些命令似乎会禁用这项新技术，这可能会造成一定的性能损失。
在将这些命令添加到游戏启动选项后，游戏可以正常启动并快速运行，所以看起来是有效的。
当然，这只是个临时解决方案，我们只能希望AMD或重生娱乐能拿出更彻底、更永久的解决方案。目前尚不清楚崩溃的原因以及可以或将会采取哪些措施，所以我们只能密切关注后续更新。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: AI is 'just a plagiarism machine that makes people lose their jobs' in the eyes of The Talos Principle 3's writers
items.summary: "They're basically incredibly intelligent versions of the autocorrect."

content.v: How many times do some of the most creative and respected figures in this industry need to explain not only why AI is not the key to making a good game, but that it's actually detrimental to creativity? Or as Dispatch's creative director cleanly put: "maybe it's a creative solution if you aren't creative".

We've seen Larian's lead writer trash talk it, saying that AI-generated text is "a 3/10 at best" . PUBG founder Brendan Greene has explained how "it's like a race to the middle of shit" as AI content becomes less and less trustworthy. When asked how Take-Two uses AI to help make successful games its CEO, Zelnick, simply said "clones don't sell" . Hell, even the king of overpromising Peter Molyneux is tepid when it comes to using it .
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/SshVsCvhn2rLPR5VaYX2cg.jpg

But here we are, beating the same damn horse that just won't die as The Talos Principle 3's writers explain why they're also cautious about AI, the lies it tries to sell, and its actual impact on this industry.

"I'm going to talk for myself," Jonas Kyratzes, narrative designer, says in an interview with Game Informer . "I think it's largely ludicrous. I think the technology itself is very impressive, and I think machine learning has tremendous applications, most of which we're currently not seeing or getting.

"I think, because in a profit-oriented system, a lot of the things that we needed to do, we're just not going to use it for, because we're going to use it for stupid things instead, for people to try and make vast amounts of money before their companies collapse."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/dzwKhKscM5eHFRy9LZUBqf.jpg

Kyratzes notes that it's not a clear-cut situation, though, as the technology itself "has a number of very interesting applications" which are unfortunately overshadowed by "these excessive quasi-religious claims" which are "not rooted in any kind of reality." Such as DeepMind's CEO claiming that humanity will experience widespread change that's "10 times bigger than the Industrial Revolution" or Altman saying the AI singularity is already upon us .

"I think a lot of them are also mainly just meant to juice up the stock market," Kyratzes adds. "It's so complicated because the current AI conversation is kind of a bit strange in that some of the time we're talking about something that we call AI, but it's not artificial general intelligence. It's LLMs or machine learning in various forms, which aren't necessarily the same as artificial intelligence in the sense of conscious being."

Kyratzes is right: We've gotten into the unhealthy habit of referring to everything that sits under the 'AI umbrella' as AI, when in a lot of cases, the actual technology is either vastly different than what we're describing it to be, has already been alive and kicking in the industry for years now, or is simply not as ground-breaking as some would have you believe.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Wsj3EM57GkqwkwyjcF2Mq4.jpg

"I'm with Jonas in that the LLMs that we're currently dealing with, they're basically incredibly intelligent versions of the autocorrect that I have on my phone," narrative designer Verena Kyratzes says. "And calling them actual AI, general AI, is just ludicrous. I think in the current system that we have, it's just a plagiarism machine that makes people lose their jobs. But I want to have hope that it's a good thing. It's very troublesome to me."

But even still AI isn't a total write-off for Kyratzes, especially since AI isn't even the sole catalyst for some of the most pressing issues which have risen around it. "I'm not against any technology in and of itself," he adds. "So, to me, a lot of the questions are not questions of the technology.

"For example, when a lot of jobs are being lost because of AI, I don't think that that's an AI issue. I think that's a labour issue. That is, why is the power of labour relative to capital so weak? So low that we can't defend ourselves against the owners just eliminating everyone? Like, what's happened to, you know, militant labor, for example. Where is that?"
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/6offQUY4CXebir2TC27dMd.jpg

items.title: 属于我们的开放世界游戏——《无限大》定档
items.summary: 科隆游戏展开展第一天的上午，触乐试玩了网易即将推出的《无限大》。 试玩版本分为两个部分，其一为剧情部分，其二为开放世界探索部分。游戏平台为PC，我们使用手柄进行游戏。去年10月，触乐曾在TGS上试玩过《无限大》。相较于当

content.v: 科隆游戏展开展第一天的上午，触乐试玩了网易即将推出的《无限大》。
试玩版本分为两个部分，其一为剧情部分，其二为开放世界探索部分。游戏平台为PC，我们使用手柄进行游戏。去年10月，触乐曾在TGS上试玩过《无限大》。相较于当年的版本而言，本次科隆游戏展提供的《无限大》试玩版本显然更为成熟，如果说当年TGS上的《无限大》试玩版本还更多地接近一种“概念呈现”的话，那么在本次科隆游戏展上，游戏版本看起来已经接近“最终可玩状态”的70%了。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-26/5766a8ebb2c33723.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
一直以来，人们对于开放世界游戏总是有一种认知，很多人觉得开放世界游戏的精髓就是大地图和无限的自由度。但我觉得这种看法是个错觉。事实上我们玩到过的最好的开放世界游戏——如果我们以《侠盗猎车手》或《2077》或《荒野大镖客》为例——开放世界游戏的精髓实际上是角色、故事和叙事。

《无限大》在科隆提供的剧情模式前半部分——基于保密协议的要求，我没法透露具体的玩法。但总体来说，整个剧情关卡的前半部分甚至可以视为一种弱操作的播片，直到剧情关卡的后半部分，操作选项逐渐放开，玩家可以进行攀爬、奔跑、跳跃等动作，整个游戏的气氛营造也愈发提升，到了后半部分结尾的地方，游戏的场面和给玩家带来的紧凑感已经达到了一种相当不错的水准，在相当长的时间里，它能够牢牢抓住我的注意力。哦对了，顺便说，游戏还有像《合金装备》致敬的部分，令人赞赏！

剧情和动画演出在开放世界游戏中是非常重要的。一个没有故事，无法吸引人的开放世界其实是没有灵魂的。很多人都幻想玩家可以在开放世界里为所欲为，但事实上，大部分玩家并没有足够的动力和创造力在开放世界里自己和自己玩，就算他们因为新鲜在一开始会这么尝试，也会很快玩腻——自古以来，已经有不少开放游戏掉进了“自由度”这个坑里。自由度只是甜点，故事才是主菜！玩家需要个性鲜明、招人喜欢的角色和吸引人的剧情才能真正融入开放世界本身。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-26/2896a8ebc17a0714.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
仍然以“侠盗猎车手”为例，如果你是个电影爱好者，就不难发现《侠盗猎车手》系列拥有最好的故事和角色，自“GTA 3”开始，很多人物的节奏、对话、人物塑造、镜头调度都非常有黄金时代的犯罪电影范儿。与“侠盗猎车手”相比，《2077》的演出就差着点儿意思——很多时候，80分的作品和95分的作品就差这么一点儿意思。
《无限大》的演出当然没有达到哪怕是《2077》的程度。但这也很正常。欧美拥有坚实的电影工业基础，游戏这方面的人才和知识一定程度是电影工业玩剩下的。在游戏开发环节中，欧美负责灯光、剧本、镜头等影像相关环节的人员专业性可以说傲视全球，我们在这一点上确实还有所差距。但是我也要说，从目前展示版本看起来，游戏相较于TGS时我玩过的版本已经有了极大的进步，我在一多半的时间里都能做到沉浸和被吸引。
《无限大》的故事看起来是发生在杭州，这个开放世界场景体现了带有我国特色的开放世界的许多特质，比如说青山绿水、人人看起来身心健康，具身智能机器人和人类和谐相处，以及——电动车。在这样美好的场景下，别说热武器，就算冷兵器也搞不到，别说汽车，就连四轮电动车也没有。最后，我操纵角色骑上了两种不同的电动车——一种是两轮的，一种是三轮拉货的。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-26/7116a8eba6e71ff8.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
在这样和谐的场景下，你当然可以骚扰别人，比如你可以攻击路人，可以用电动车撞他，可以吓唬他，但你也别想引发任何混乱。一切都是淡淡的但顺顺的，这里就像桃花源一样美好。
但我注意到，电动车的车速相较于TGS时期的汽车速度大幅度提升了。我记得当时汽车的车速很低（如果以现实世界为例，大概是10-20Km/h），我想这可能主要是因为技术问题导致的。现在电动车看起来也可以达到国标上限25Km/h了——我的意思是，载具的速度快起来了！而且驾驶感觉还不错。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-26/6636a8ebadb67978.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
别看我说了这么多看起来不太好的话，但实际上，我要强调的是，那种“我熟悉的世界变成了游戏”的感觉是非常令人沉迷的。我当然可以挑出许多不足，但所有的不足加在一起乘以10，也无法抵消那种“我可以在屏幕中感受我生活的地方”给我带来的那种快乐和投入感。
知道吗，在我小时候，我最羡慕的就是纽约和洛杉矶人。因为我看过很多好莱坞电影，那些电影往往就发生在美国，纽约或者洛杉矶的街道上。我经常想，一个纽约人看到这些电影会怎么想？看着那些故事就发生在自己身边的场景里，会是一种什么感觉？一个纽约人看完《金刚》，然后出门看到帝国大厦，他的感受是什么样子的？又或者，一个洛杉矶人玩《侠盗猎车手 5》的感觉是什么样的？他会不会有一些我永远无法体会到的感受？
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-26/6866a8ebcb021ec0.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700

从某种意义上，我觉得拥有这种感受是经济和文化繁荣的一种附带福利。从另一个角度讲，一个现实题材的开放世界游戏本来就必然构筑在一种传播极广、受众极多、拥有广泛基础的文化上。就像《侠盗猎车手》实际上是浓缩和概括了整个美国流行文化一样——有无数在全球受到欢迎的电影、电视剧和小说为它共同构建了一个吸引人的世界设定，在玩这款游戏的时候，玩家实际上是在感受整个美国流行文化。这款游戏在全世界的流行，实际上也是美国文化在全世界范围内占据压倒性影响力的流行。
那么《无限大》呢？我同样认为我们到了一个时候，可以用游戏这种产品形态，把我们所有受欢迎的流行文化集中呈现出来。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-26/9706a8ebde631458.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700
值得一提的是，《无限大》已在本届gamescom开幕夜正式定档，将于2027年1月15日全球上线。这款备受关注的都市开放世界RPG，终于距离真正与玩家见面又近了一步。
http://img.chuapp.com/wp-content/Picture/2026-08-26/3566a8eb99e459a0.jpg?imageView2/2/w/700

items.title: Persona 4 Revival Shows That Some RPG Classics Don’t Need Much Fixing
items.summary: Persona 4 is no stranger to the remaster scene, but next year, it's getting a glow-up that fans of the series

content.v: Persona 4 is no stranger to the remaster scene, but next year, it's getting a glow-up that fans of the series have been patiently waiting for. Similar to Persona 3: Reload, Persona 4: Revival updates the original game with slick graphics, new combat features, and adjustments to the story to filter out some of its more unsavory elements. And based on what we've played so far? It's looking like a pretty good and faithful return to the not-so-sleepy town of Inaba.

Visually, Atlus is once again firing on all cylinders with the presentation of Persona 4: Revival. The menus look especially good while also paying homage to Persona 4, and the whole game leans hard into the analog TV aesthetic with various elements. Beyond that, the game's graphics naturally represent a noticeable upgrade compared to the PS2 original. Environments now pop with more details, character models look great in 3D, and there are also brand-new anime cutscenes alongside 3D-animated sequences. Basically, if you're a fan of Persona 5 and Persona 3: Reload's visual storytelling, you'll feel right at home here.

On the audio side, Persona 4: Revival also features a strong cast of voice actors who bring the primary cast to life. There may be new voices behind each character, but the cast does a solid job of embodying each member of the Persona 4 gang, matching the tone and energy of the protagonists.
If Persona 4 looks and sounds good, how does it play then?

When it comes to combat, there are a few noticeable changes as well. The biggest is the Baton Pass, which was originally from Persona 5, then added in Persona 3 Reload, and now it is here. Atlus is really making the Baton Pass sort of a core part of Persona's combat. The other new mechanic is Prime Time. You have a meter that fills up over time, and when it's full, you activate Prime Time. This will give you several turns where you can freely use any ability you want without spending any SP or HP. You can Baton Pass, change Persona, and then finish a fight with a Showtime attack when you're ready. Think of it as an ace up your sleeve that you'll want to save for particularly tough encounters.
I appreciate the added flashiness of Prime Time, but I'll be honest: it doesn't feel like it dramatically changes Persona Four's combat in a big, substantial way.

A long-standing issue we've had with Persona games is that every time they release a special edition or a remake, they always add new mechanics that end up making the combat feel significantly easier. I will give credit to Prime Time in that I don't feel like they just added another flashy win button, the way some mechanics added to Persona games feel. But at the same time, I didn't feel like it was an incredible new mechanic I was very excited about. It's a cool addition, but I don't find it to be a game-changer.

Atlus has proven it knows how to remake its Persona games. So far, this is very much Persona 4 Golden, but it looks nicer and has a couple of new gameplay mechanics. We'll just have to wait and see if Atlus has any surprises in store for us when the game comes out early next year.

items.title: Even GTA 6 Is Poking Fun At Naughty Dog’s Lack Of New Games
items.summary: While Naughty Dog is working on its next title, Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet, that hasn't stopped people

content.v: While Naughty Dog is working on its next title, Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet, that hasn't stopped people from taking a jab at the studio for having spent almost the entire PlayStation 5 generation without releasing a brand-new game--and it looks like even GTA 6 is having a little bit of fun at Naughty Dog's expense.

The recent GTA 6 leaks from Cyberleek have been a treasure trove of information about the game, especially the amount of detail that can be found in virtually every corner of it. One such detail you might easily miss is a collection of video game covers, one of which is a thinly veiled reference to the video game series The Last of Us. As seen in the screenshot below, players can find a copy of We Came Together: 1, 2, & 3 Remasters of the Remixes.

The text used here is very similar to the logo of The Last of Us, complete with a splash of orange to break it all up. It's not the only studio that GTA 6 is parodying, as you can even find a cover for what's probably a souls-like game on the shelf:

The ribbing of The Last of Us likely stems from the fact that, compared to the PS3 and PS4 eras, Naughty Dog's output for PS5 has been much smaller. There are a number of reasons for that, as the increased complexity of developing modern video games means that a project can take several years to complete. The multi-year development and eventual cancellation of The Last of Us Online also consumed massive studio resources for years and ended without a finished product.

In the PS5 era, Naughty Dog's output has consisted of remastered editions and PC ports of its Uncharted and The Last of Us games. The studio's next game, Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet , is still listed as a PS5 game, and another report claims that the studio is crunching hard to have it out by mid-2027. If the game does arrive next year, it'll be the first new release from Naughty Dog that isn't a remake or a remaster since 2020's The Last of Us Part 2, and it's rumored that a second team is working on The Last of Us: Part III .

As for Rockstar Games, it'll be showing off an official look at GTA 6 on August 27 , after weathering a week of leaks. The GTA 6 leaker hasn't been identified yet, but former Rockstar North director Obbe Vermeij has commented on the situation and he believes that they aren't as big a deal as the internet would have you believe--or at least, they aren't nearly as bad as the infamous Hot Coffee scandal .

items.title: We’ve Seen The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past in Action, and It’s Looking Like Another Blood & Wine | gamescom 2026
items.summary: We've seen The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past in action - learn about everything we saw on Geralt's new quest to

others.title: We saw The Witcher 3 – Songs of the Past in action, and the full-game remaster that's coming this year too

content.v: This is a shorter version of an exclusive Witcher 3 – Songs of the Past cover feature that will go out in the next issue of PC Gamer magazine . Keep your eyes peeled!

Surprise! Songs of the Past, The Witcher 3's third expansion, isn't kicked off by some Ciri-centric weft in the space-time continuum, nor another curt and urgent letter from Yennefer. As for Triss, well, I didn't spot a single red hair of her in the hands-off demo that CD Projekt Red and Fool's Theory gave us.

It's Dandelion. Geralt's lute-plucking biographer has gone missing, and who better to find him than his best pal in the whole wide world? So when Songs of the Past releases next year, he'll be back on the path in a region of The Witcher's world we've never seen before—Dandelion's family home of Letten, in the kingdom of Redania.
And he's got another surprise for you, too: a full Witcher 3 remaster that aims to make the 2015 classic feel like it released in the modern era, due for release on September 29.
Over a decade since The Witcher 3's last expansion, the boys are back in town.
There's No Place Like

Where better to get a glimpse of Dandelion's true face than his family home? Dandelion's real name is Julian Alfred Pankratz, Viscount de Lettenhove, and it's to Lettenhove he invites Geralt for Songs of the Past's opening—to the sumptuous manor that marks the seat of power for his blue-blood forebears.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/6cyp4NU7LGwe6oKG9xWNaB.jpg

To hear the devs tell it, this is a Dandelion-centric expansion all the way through: the focus is on Geralt and the bard's relationship—their "bromance," as multiple people I spoke to put it—and not so much on, oh I don't know, Ciri, for example.

"[Letten is] a completely new region in northern Redania, where Dandelion comes from," says Karolina Kuzia, Songs of the Past's vision director. "We visit because of personal matters that put a toll on him, so he needs his best friend at his side. Imagine you enter a lush green valley, hidden in a mountain range."
"This place was never touched by war, never ravaged like the rest of the continent," continues Kuzia. "People here are peaceful. They live their lives together with nature."
Not too peaceful, though. "Letten, albeit a land of plenty, has a dark underbelly," says game director Jakub Rokosz. "It wouldn't be a Witcher adventure if Geralt didn't have anything to do."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/6xx6QPJ9wquSJ8XfVCv6zB.jpg
The morning after

That dark underbelly was there from the jump in my time with Songs of the Past. Geralt awakens, hungover and far from home, in the aftermath of the local Belleteyn celebrations—a kind of Easter-style celebration—but in the party's afterglow, Dandelion is nowhere to be found.

A pretty walk later and the witcher is sat at a long mahogany table in Lettenhove itself, playing mediator between two of his best friend's most fearsome relatives, his grandmama and his cousin Lilla, as they argue over whether Dandelion is truly missing at all and, if so, what to do about it.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/7o4VPFiEEH9GaeXUDGK5nB.jpg
Yes, we absolutely asked if you can romance grandmama, and I'm sorry to say it sounds like the answer is no.

Anyway, it's not long before Geralt's Belleteyn turns into a busman's holiday. He and the almost-definitely-romanceable Lilla venture out into Letten's gnarled, dark, and foreboding woods on the trail of a de Lettenhove family legend: the curse of Dandelion's ancestor, the mad Count Humbert de Lettenhove.
Given that it's been a while since The Witcher 3 last got an expansion, it might be worth saying something obvious: this is still The Witcher 3 at its core, with the loops and mechanics you remember.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/JFCtKrQ2PjVqaGrZYbiEzB.jpg

Soon after starting, the dev playing the demo I saw was dropping into his witcher senses to find lost items and people, and the expansion's first contretemps—an argument between Geralt and a bearded Letten-ite who had snaffled Dandelion's lute—let the player choose between trying to negotiate a peaceful settlement or resorting to the diplomacy of fists. We picked the latter.

"I wouldn't say that [Songs of the Past] will feel different," says Rokosz, "simply because Witcher 3 aged really well, as a game. It's still very relevant—it became a staple for RPGs back in the day when it came out, and even now, when you replay it, you don't really feel it's an old game."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/jRKGoCQDQEuYFLpWCYoEfB.jpg
Chain reaction

But while it's still The Witcher 3, it quite literally has some new tricks up its sleeve. Geralt picks up a new weapon in the course of his time in Letten: a silver chain that wraps around his arm and can be used to handle crowds of enemies. You might recognise it. In The Witcher 1's intro cinematic (and in the first book), Geralt used exactly this weapon to fight off a monstrous striga.
And if you don't remember that, you might recall this: Ciri wields an identical weapon in cinematic trailers for The Witcher 4. Cue raised eyebrows.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/xn3oWMpy5EJtr7KoWkKBzB.jpg

How does it work? I saw Geralt make use of his new weapon against a couple of different enemies in my time with him. First up, swarmions, a new enemy type and example par excellence of nominative determinism. They're big on swarming, you see, which means having a long chain to handle them with—yanking individual foes from the pack to deal with mano a mano, or whipping it around to keep foes at bay—comes in useful.

The chain is selected much like a sign or bomb in combat, and can either be quickly deployed with a button press or, if you want to give someone special treatment, you can manually zoom in to target specific body parts on your enemies, an action which slows down time to give you time to aim, much like the base game's crossbow.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/Mm6SQooFki9yagZDumwLzB.jpg

I also saw the chain used in my demo's concluding boss fight. Having hacked their way through centipedes, swarmions, and a few other nasties, Lilla and Geralt finally come to a mystical well that seems intricately tied to Dandelion's disappearance and the de Lettenhove curse. First things first, though, Geralt has to put down the Slumbering Knight guarding the place, which means plenty of familiar fancy footwork while, at the same time, using your new toy to break the boss's guard and get some licks in.
(Re)master Witcher

That familiar fancy footwork isn't too familiar, mind you. A new expansion isn't the only work being done on CDPR's masterpiece—the studio is preceding Songs of the Past with a full-on remaster too. It's not just a graphical gussy-up, the devs are reworking parts of the game to smooth out the little points of aggravation that might drive players away.

When it comes to gameplay changes, "We're mostly thinking about new players, you know?" says Jakub Kutrzuba, CDPR's executive producer of external projects. "We're looking at The Witcher from that perspective—so what would be the biggest pain points? What would a player expect to be changed in order to enjoy the game?" What would The Witcher 3 look like "if it was a game which released in 2026"?
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/uJmU2osA5R22vmBN4Ma7fB.jpg
In practice, that means working on The Witcher 3's combat, movement, and animations to make the whole thing feel more responsive and dynamic and less, well, janky.

"The remaster includes so many improvements, so many fixes, so many changes and gameplay improvements," says Badowski. "All the improvements make the combat much more smooth, much more natural. You can change target while playing the animation or performing strikes, and it gives the game a kind of freshness."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/VD3TfR3Zn5MaJ2ryEFQpjB.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/27JXeh6iRXApDb2h2tgMzB.jpg
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/UiHQzGbgDWuTSBXL62v4Fd.jpg

items.title: 《GTA6》媒体情报解禁时间定了！R星官方互动确认

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608262025331082.jpg
近日，知名游戏博主TGG发文透露，他于上月受邀前往坐落于爱丁堡的Rockstar North总部，获取了大量《GTA6》的独家一手情报。

https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608262025553197.png
据悉，R星已经向部分油管创作者以及游戏媒体开放《GTA6》专场闭门预览活动。博主表示，待Netflix独家首播重磅的“Extended Look（扩展前瞻）”宣传片上线后，他就会对外公开自己的全部见闻。这条推文也获得了R星官方账号的点赞互动，证实本次媒体预览确有其事。

items.title: 韩国"19禁"古装剧定档9.18 上演情欲多角恋戏码
items.summary: 近日，备受瞩目的大尺度新剧《挑情丑闻》确定将于9月18日上线。

content.v: 近日，备受瞩目的大尺度新剧《挑情丑闻》确定将于9月18日上线。
该剧由孙艺珍、池昌旭、林珍儿（NANA）领衔主演，三位实力派演员将联袂演绎一部“19禁”古装罗曼史，大胆挑战情欲与道德边界。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260826_zy_red_164_16/198.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260826_zy_red_164_16/1101.jpg

《挑情丑闻》翻拍自2003年上映的韩国情色电影《丑闻—朝鲜男女相悦之事》，而该片原作则改编自法国著名小说《危险关系》，将故事背景移植到十八世纪朝鲜王朝末期。剧版由孙艺珍、池昌旭、林珍儿主演，以欲望本身即为禁忌的朝鲜时代为舞台，讲述了一场挑战严苛儒教秩序的胆大妄为的爱情游戏——上流社会的花花公子赵元（池昌旭 饰）、工于心计的赵氏夫人（孙艺珍 饰）以及守节九年的寡妇淑夫人（林珍儿 饰）之间，因一场赌注而引发的致命诱惑、背叛与复仇。据悉，剧中将有大量激情戏和床戏，视觉呈现华丽而危险。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260826_zy_red_164_16/1348.jpg
现年44岁的孙艺珍已许久未推出影视新作，上一部作品还是2022年的《三十九》。此前她凭借《经常请吃饭的漂亮姐姐》《爱的迫降》等浪漫爱情剧深入人心，电影代表作《假如爱有天意》《我脑中的橡皮擦》《现在去见你》也多为纯爱路线。此次她大胆突破，在《挑情丑闻》中饰演赵氏夫人——一位将男性玩弄于股掌之间的狠角色。她与池昌旭饰演的赵元大演情欲戏，并主动设下诱惑赌局，展现出顶级谋略家的冷艳魅力。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260826_zy_red_164_16/1543.jpg
39岁的池昌旭近年作品频出，接连主演《恶中之恶》《欢迎回到三达里》《于氏王后》《江南B-Side》《操控游戏》等剧。此前他在古装剧《于氏王后》中已有大尺度激情戏表现。此次在《挑情丑闻》中，他饰演的赵元才貌双全、琴棋书画样样精通，是不信爱情、只享情欲的放荡公子。在赵氏夫人的怂恿下，他前去勾引其他女子，却意外邂逅了由NANA饰演的淑夫人，由此引爆一场惊心动魄的爱情风暴。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260826_zy_red_164_16/1732.jpg
34岁的林珍儿（NANA）曾出演《Kill It》《Justice》《出师表》《Oh！珠仁君》《天外谜踪》《Climax》等剧，凭借《假面女郎》收获高人气。本次她在剧中饰演淑夫人郑熙延，一位守寡20年的端庄严正女子。失去丈夫后她坚守妇道，却最终未能抵挡赵元的诱惑，压抑多年的欲望倾泻而出，两人展开轰轰烈烈的禁忌之恋，更引发赵氏夫人的嫉妒与醋意，三人间危险又充满诱惑的爱情赌局一触即发。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260826_zy_red_164_16/1929.jpg
《挑情丑闻》集结了顶级卡司与大胆题材，预计将成为今年秋季最具话题性的韩剧之一，敬请期待9月18日Netflix全球上线。

others.title: R星官方回应《GTA6》泄露！倍感痛心 深表歉意

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608261938429071.jpg
就在今日，Rockstar Games发布公开信，针对近期《GTA6》大规模实机泄露事件正式作出回应。
R星表示，以泄露视频这种形式让玩家见到《GTA6》，对整个开发团队来说十分令人痛心，这并不是官方想要呈现给玩家的方式。官方为此向玩家致歉，游戏目前开发已经接近完工，后续会放出更多细节与官方实机内容。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608261939005203.jpg
官方透露，明天就会带来游戏的加长版内容展示。虽然筹备周期超出预想，但R星强调会努力交出超出玩家期待的作品。尽管泄露带来的剧透已经破坏了部分体验，R星依旧希望玩家能够耐心等候，在11月19日亲自上手感受完整游戏。
同时R星也感谢社区玩家给予开发团队的鼓励与支持，称正是玩家才赋予他们制作游戏的意义，后续还会继续分享更多情报。
具体公告如下：
致各位：
我们知道，过去一周很多玩家都在等待我们就近期事件作出回应。毫不夸张地说，《GTA6》实机视频以这种方式泄露，令我们整个团队倍感痛心。这绝非我们原本计划的形式，让大家在时隔这么久之后看到这款游戏。对于各项工作耗时如此之久，我们深表歉意 —— 从完成游戏开发（现已接近完工！），到公布更多细节、官方实机演示，再到向玩家社区奉上大家想要了解的全部内容。
我们十分期待，明天让大家看到更多游戏内容。这份内容的筹备耗时超出预期，但一如我们所有的工作，我们明白必须做到超出各位的期待，并且决心交出符合大家预期、配得上大家期待的作品。虽然很遗憾，部分剧透可能已经影响到原本完整的游戏体验，但我们仍希望大家能够再多等待一段时间，在11月19日亲自体验本作。
感谢过去一周社区中所有发来鼓励与支持的各位 —— 你们的话语对团队而言意义难以估量。说到底，我们是为各位玩家制作这款游戏，没有你们，我们便无缘从事游戏开发这份事业。
期待很快能和大家分享更多消息。
此致
Rockstar Games

items.summary: 《古神：风里希》是一款以中国创世神话为背景的ARPG。你将化身华夏创世神女娲以土、水、火创造的首个生灵——灵珠子，投身于诸多经…

content.v: 《古神：风里希》是一款以中国创世神话为背景的ARPG。你将化身华夏创世神女娲以土、水、火创造的首个生灵——灵珠子，投身于诸多经典创世神话篇章，与身形巍峨的巨神酣战，尽享独树一帜的中式仙神对决体验。
今日，本作的PS5商店页面也已正式上线。游戏支持PS5 Pro强化。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608262006594646.jpg
游戏介绍： 《古神: 风里希》是一款以中国创世神话为背景的ARPG。你将化身华夏创世神女娲以土、水、火创造的首个生灵——灵珠子，投身于诸多经典创世神话篇章，与身形巍峨的巨神酣战，尽享独树一帜的中式仙神对决体验。
洪荒浩劫，英雄抉择
创世神盘古沉睡后，天地陷入混沌：十日当空，大地被炙烤成赤红荒漠；众神征战，苍穹碎裂；天柱崩塌，妖魔鬼怪从深渊倾巢而出。你身负女娲赐予的 “灵珠之心”，面对众神不同的指引，你的选择无谓对错，但将决定世界的走向。
“女娲造人” —— 风里希，乃女娲的真名，作为女娲按照自身模样，以土为骨、以水为脉、以火为魂打造的 “器”—— 灵珠子，你本是混沌乱世里的一缕微光。女娲不仅用黄土塑造了你的躯体，更赠与一颗注入神水的 “心” —— 这颗心既是你力量的源头，更是陪伴你闯过万难的第一个 “伙伴”，它让你天生拥有调动水之神力的能力，补天、寻己，在旅途里完成从 “器” 到第一个 “人” 的蜕变，揭开华夏创世神话的面纱。
神仙打架战斗系统：斗法、双架势、化玄与法宝神通
斗法系统：以 “器（血条）” 为基础、“神力（神力对抗条）”为核心对抗，初始按敌我神力比值划分；战斗中可通过攻防手段调控神力，触发高风险高威力的 EX 神通或用红光神通技反制强攻。玩家可择压制强攻或控场反击，神力打空者会陷入崩溃，对手需趁机破坏其器，取得胜利。
地空双架势：地面可施展刚猛近战连招，空中能利用水的势能的展开高速空战，从云端俯冲突袭到地面蓄力反击，完美复刻 “神仙打架” 的无界快感；
水之化形：借助神水之力，你可“化玄”为传说神祇的形态，施展专属EX技能；
法宝神通：搜集后羿弓、芭蕉扇、等神器后，可释放融合技，构筑出独属于你的战斗风格。
巨神与通天树
依托虚幻5引擎与次世代技术，游戏打造独树一帜的中式巨物冒险：你将攀爬身形巍峨如山的上古神祇，借力其躯体脉络展开战斗；更需借助巨人夸父之力，攀登上连接人神两界的扶桑通天树，登顶后挽弓射落九日，终结大地炙烤的浩劫。
水之哲学
生命来源于水，力量也应如此，游戏融入上善若水的哲学，灵珠心脏封存神水，战斗时挤压催动运转，注入自身或法宝即可强化战力。招式更融入寸拳一闪凝水为劲，近战破防；龙踢如水龙摆尾，速攻横扫。不同神水运用策略，练就精准防御、后发先至的截击打法。
开发者的话 —— 拥抱神话传承
我们一直景仰着女娲补天、后羿射日的故事。这些神话人物，是古籍中的名讳，是壁画上的朦胧剪影，更是跨越岁月却难以触及的传奇。
在《古神: 风里希》里，告别旁观者的身份：执起灵珠之心，踏风火轮遨游天地，解锁神通，投身补天的洪荒之战。亲身参与这些神话盛事的震撼，是任何文字故事都无法比拟的。
我们的心愿，是还原中国神话中那些荡气回肠的仙神对决，让每一次神通施展、每一次抉择取舍、每一场浴血奋战，都为这个时代书写全新的神话篇章。
我们由衷期盼，各位玩家能亲身感受中国神话的磅礴与热血，享受这段独特的冒险之旅。

items.title: Apex Legends is getting 'fatal error' crashes with RX 9070 XT GPUs, but there is a workaround
items.summary: Just paste a few commands into the Steam launch options.

content.v: Apex Legends seems to be having trouble working with the AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT right now. As relayed by the Apex Legends account ApexCommunityJP on X (machine translated), "We have confirmed an issue causing crashes for players using the AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT GPU, and we are currently investigating the cause."

I can confirm on my end that Apex Legends crashes when I try to launch it using a rig with an RX 9070 XT. I get the following game/engine 'fatal error': "The application's device failed due to badly formed commands sent by the application. This is a design-time issue that should be investigated and fixed."
現在、AMD Radeon RX 9070 XTのGPUをご使用のプレイヤーにおいて、クラッシュが発生する不具合を確認しており、原因の調査を行っております。本件の一時的な回避策として、グラフィックドライバーのバージョンを以前の「26.7.1」へロールバックすることをお試しいただけますようお願い申し上げます。 August 26, 2026
The aforementioned X account does recommend trying to roll back your AMD graphics driver; however, some replies to this claim that doing so doesn't resolve the problem.

One suggestion in the replies that does seem to have worked for me as a temporary workaround is to add the following to the game's Steam launch options: "+staticprop_color_use_bindless 0 +staticprop_depth_use_bindless 0 +r_drawworld_depth_bindless 0" . To do so, on the game's Steam page, click the cog, then Properties, then paste those commands into the launch options.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/mNvEFYDZcJNaMvQX6ihVpb.jpg

These seem to be options related to bindless rendering, which is where the GPU accesses shaders without mediation from the CPU. It looks like these commands disable that newer tech, which could mean a bit of a performance hit. I can confirm that adding these commands to my game's launch options did allow me to boot up and have a quick game, so it looks like it works.

Of course, it's only a workaround, and we'll have to hope AMD or Respawn come up with a proper fix for something a little cleaner and more permanent. It's unclear at this time what is causing the crashes and what can or will be done about it, so we'll just have to keep our eyes peeled for updates.

content.v: 过去一周，《GTA6》泄露视频频出，R星刚刚发布了声明，向粉丝们致歉，因为大家等待更多信息和官方游戏演示的时间太长了。官方将于8月28日发布游戏的完整演示。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260826/1787746516_529790_jpg_r.jpg
以下是完整声明：
各位，
我们知道，很多玩家都在等待我们解释过去一周发生的事情。毫不夸张地说，《GTA6》的游戏视频以这种方式泄露，对我们的团队来说无疑是令人心碎的。显然，我们并不希望大家在经历了这么长时间的等待后，最终看到这款游戏。对于所有事情的进展如此缓慢，我们深感抱歉——从游戏开发（几乎完成！）到分享更多细节和官方游戏视频，再到为玩家社区提供你们想知道的一切，我们都付出了巨大的努力。
我们非常激动地期待大家明天看到完整版预览。虽然准备工作比预期花费的时间更长，但正如我们所做的一切，我们深知必须超越大家的期望，我们也决心以你们期望和应得的高水准呈现游戏内容。尽管剧透可能会影响到部分玩家的游戏体验，但我们仍希望大家能够耐心等待，在11月19日亲自体验游戏。
我们要感谢过去一周里所有发来支持信息的社区成员——你们的鼓励对我们团队意义非凡。归根结底，我们制作这款游戏是为了你们，没有你们，我们就无法从事游戏制作。
我们期待尽快与您分享更多信息。
此致，
Rockstar Games

items.title: Rockstar Finally Comments On All Those GTA 6 Leaks — “Heartbreaking For Our Team”
items.summary: Rockstar Games has broken its silence on the GTA 6 leak situation , releasing a statement today, August 26, sa

content.v: Rockstar Games has broken its silence on the GTA 6 leak situation , releasing a statement today, August 26, saying the leaks have been "heartbreaking for our team."

The latest wave of GTA 6 gameplay leaks began earlier this month, with lots and lots of footage and details, along with spoilers, emerging in the process. GTA 6 also suffered a massive leak in 2022, and Rockstar and Take-Two found the person responsible , but that hasn't happened yet with this latest leak.

"It would be an understatement to say that having videos of GTA 6 gameplay leak in this way has been heartbreaking for our team, and this is obviously not how we intended for you to see the game after all this time," Rockstar added.

Rockstar will show off GTA 6 during a Netflix event on August 27. Rockstar added that getting the video together "has taken longer than we wanted," but "we know we need to exceed your expectations." The event takes place on August 27 at 3 PM ET, and the video will be reshared on YouTube later that day.

"While it is unfortunate that the intended game experience may now be impacted by some spoilers, we hope that everyone will wait a bit longer to experience the game for themselves on November 19," Rockstar added.

"We want to thank everyone in the community who has reacted out with messages of support this past week--your words have meant more to this team than you can imagine. Ultimately, we are making this game for you, and without you, we would not have the privilege of making games."

Keep checking back with GameSpot for lots more on GTA 6. The game launches on November 19 for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar is charging $80 for the base game and $100 for a premium edition that includes a lot of extras.
GTA 6 has been described as a single-player experience, and it remains to be seen how Rockstar may evolve GTA Online for GTA 6. Whatever happens, Rockstar's decision is sure to piss people off .

items.title: 实体盘也有寿命！玩家用了15年的Xbox盘分层报废
items.summary: 近日一名玩家的遭遇，引发不少玩家共鸣。他分享了自己珍藏近15年的Xbox 360版《上古卷轴5：天际》，并透露这张光盘在经历多年使用后…

content.v: 玩家囧事： 一张陪伴玩家近15年的《上古卷轴5》实体盘因光盘分层彻底报废，实体盘终也逃不过岁月侵蚀。
近日一名玩家的遭遇，引发不少玩家共鸣。他分享了自己珍藏近15年的Xbox 360版《上古卷轴5：天际》，并透露这张光盘在经历多年使用后，如今因光盘分层已经无法读取。
该玩家回忆称，自己是在2011年11月11日《上古卷轴5：天际》发售当天，于美国芝加哥一家GameStop参加午夜发售活动时买到这张游戏。当时这是他参加的最后一次大型午夜发售活动，因此至今仍对那个夜晚印象深刻。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608261945454428.png
他还回忆称，自己当时刚开始接触摩托车，骑的是一辆2003款川崎Z1000。拿到游戏后，他直接把光盘塞进摩托车后座，随后一路赶回家。第二天，他和朋友们一起进入Xbox 360派对语音聊天，虽然每个人都在玩自己的游戏，但大家一直聊天、分享着对《天际》的兴奋。
这张游戏还有一些特殊之处。玩家发现，自己的游戏说明书存在印刷错误，封面被印了两张。此外，这还是游戏发售首日的初版光盘，尚未经过任何更新。
如今，陪伴他近15年的这张光盘却已经开始在中心区域出现分层现象，最终无法被Xbox 360读取。“服役了15年，我没什么好难过的，但还是希望它能坚持得更久一些。”玩家写道，并以经典的“按F致敬”表达了自己的感慨。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608261945536166.png
帖子发布后，不少网友表示，这张游戏光盘承载的回忆已经远比游戏本身更加珍贵。有网友建议：“这显然是一段很棒的回忆，也许可以把它装框保存起来？”
对此，该玩家回应称，自己确实考虑过这么做。他计划将游戏光盘、外壳、印刷错误的说明书以及地图册一起装框收藏。
也有网友感慨：“我以前从不知道光盘也会坏掉。”有玩家科普任何存储介质最终都会老化，无论是光盘、机械硬盘、SSD、U盘，甚至书籍、卷轴和石碑，只是不同介质的寿命有所不同。有些东西在妥善保存的情况下甚至能够跨越数代人，但最终都难以避免消失。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608261946095558.png

items.title: Crimson Desert's 2.0 update's most surprising change is an effort to make Kliff a fully realised character with thoughts and opinions
items.summary: Kliff climbing.

others.title: 10.1.0 | Chorus of Sin

content.v: Crimson Desert didn't get its jaws into me as deep as I'd hoped—partially because of its somewhat scattershot, overwhelming nature . This is purely a matter of personal taste, mind. If I weren't obligated to keep up with new games, my MMOs of choice, and y'know, social obligations, I probably would've gotten arm-deep within Pearl Abyss' systems-driven buffet.

I do have to give its developer credit, though. Crimson Desert has been utterly flooded with free updates without any sign of actually stopping. The latest in this long line is the "Crimson Desert Enhanced" patch, which is live now on PC and was announced during Gamescom 2026 opening night live .

In terms of nitty-gritty gameplay changes, it'll now be easier to get skill points for all three of the main cast, rather than having to ration out your Abyss Artefacts across all of 'em. There's also eight new skills for main man Kliff himself, UI tweaks, and bug fixes.

But the premier feature of this patch is a re-tuning of the game's main story—it's unclear how deep this goes, but doing some digging and watching playthroughs (such as this helpful primer by YouTube channel GamingBolt ) shows Kliff's first foray into the abyss accompanied by a mournful reflection on his history with his Greymane companions. Meaningful story—or lack thereof—was a major complaint on launch for Crimson Desert, so it's nice to see Pearl Abyss trying to turn Kliff into more than a gruff yes man.

He's no longer completely lacking in introspection, either. In the same video, we join Kliff several months later not nattering to some random jobber, but actually thinking about the crazy magical events that have led him to this point. Character development? Could it be?

I'm yet to invent time travel, so I haven't had 60 spare hours to chew through the opening questlines of Crimson Desert's revamped story to tell you whether it does a good job or not, but I'm honestly charmed by the effort, anyway.

I legitimately think Pearl Abyss could've simply gotten away with allowing the game's storyline to take a backseat, but recognising and addressing that major complaint—the scattershot, absurd nature of the game's opening hours—is a valiant task to take on.

items.title: 靠《我的滑板鞋》烂出名的庞麦郎 十年后还能开演唱会
items.summary: 摩擦摩擦，摩擦摩擦......

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2022/10/21/small_202210211829418927.png
10年代上网冲过浪的朋友们，肯定都听说过《我的滑板鞋》这首旷世神作。
它算不上好听，却因为魔性洗脑一度席卷全网，将《小苹果》《最炫民族风》等有力竞争者一并斩于马下，坐上了“第一神曲”的宝座。它的演唱者约瑟翰·庞麦郎也因为这首歌一炮走红，荣膺“2014年度十大新人歌手”之首。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260826_zhb_736_1/1455.jpg
十余年后的今天，庞麦郎早就没了任何热度，但依旧开着演唱会，在小红书和抖音直播唱歌，哪怕根本没什么观众。
他只是一直乐此不疲地唱着他的成名曲《我的滑板鞋》。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260826_zhb_736_1/1853.jpg
庞明涛，或者说约瑟翰·庞麦郎，生于陕西农村的一户贫困人家，早早就辍了学，出门打工补贴家用。
他曾在汉中的一家KTV里打工切果盘，在那里见识了迈克尔·杰克逊，这位国际巨星给了刚走出山村的庞麦郎巨大的震撼，也让庞麦郎开始憧憬成为一名歌手。
他没有声乐基础，更别提接受专业训练，但他还是带着自己的歌词本前往北京，希望在大城市实现自己的梦想。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260826_zhb_736_1/11344.jpg
来到北京后，庞麦郎委托一名音乐制作人为自己作词的《打吊针》谱曲。而这位倒霉的制作人拿到清唱版本之后听得两眼一黑，完全不着调地演唱让他根本无从下手，不得不上网求救。
庞麦郎的大作一经公开便引得业内人士群嘲，但也有一群图个猎奇的乐手为这首唐歌制作了各种风格的remix版。其中一版融合了电子和R&B风格的版本甚至成功地出了圈，被制作成各了种鬼畜MAD，一度火爆13年互联网。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260826_zhb_736_1/11850.jpg
但此时的盛况似乎又和庞麦郎本人没什么关系，他的北漂生活称得上凄惨——面试音乐公司失败，参加选秀落选，一度身无分文流落街头，每天只能睡在公园里。
事情还是迎来了转机，在《摩的大飚客》出圈后的2013年9月，一家音乐传媒公司看中了庞麦郎身上的流量潜力，将庞麦郎签约至自己门下。
后面的事情我们都知道了，第二年《我的滑板鞋》正式发行，火遍大江南北。
不过如今来看，那首魔怔又上头的神曲，恐怕不能完全算作庞麦郎一个人的作品。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260826_zhb_736_1/12379.jpg
开头动感的旋律显然不是一个对乐理一窍不通的人自己捣鼓出来的。他本人也甚至无法进行一次完整的录音，每次录出来的效果都截然不同，最终成曲是调音师从海量录音素材中截取可用的片段，一段一段拼接而成的，制作难度不亚于哈基米音乐。
但这些都不重要了，《我的滑板鞋》成功迎合了彼时大众的猎奇审丑心理，带来了完全超乎预期的热度和收益。制作公司的梭哈成功了，庞麦郎本人也一夜成名，实现了自己的歌手梦。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260826_zhb_736_1/12891.jpg
公司决定趁热打铁，为庞麦郎安排了二百多场商演，但都被庞麦郎以“损毁自己巨星形象”的理由拒绝了，签约时就确认好的二八分成在如今的他看来也不可理喻，他认为这简直就是在把自己当黑奴使。
庞麦郎最终选择了消失，与公司分道扬镳，他离开了北京，逃到上海生活。
此时是2015年初，庞麦郎在网络上的热度如日中天，他被虾米音乐评为“年度十大新人”之首，《我的滑板鞋》也位列2014年网络洗脑神曲第一，但他本人正蜗居在上海的一家小旅馆中，早已与外界断联。
没过多久，一篇名为《惊惶庞麦郎》的报道文章横空出世，将庞麦郎逃离北京后的生活赤裸裸的展示在大众面前。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260826_zhb_736_1/13481.jpg
这篇文章中的庞麦郎颓废又傲慢：他坚持营造来自中国台湾省的人设，却连自己的故乡基隆在哪都分不清；明明拒绝了公司安排的所有商演，却不停寻找着廉价的私活儿；他以完全不可理喻的理由拒绝了所有正规电视台的邀约，还时不时对着上门采访的记者气急败坏...
《惊惶庞麦郎》引起了巨大的争议，撰稿人本人遭到网暴，庞麦郎本人也被指责为骗子和精神病，他认为自己的巨星人设随着这篇报道彻底崩塌了。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260826_zhb_736_1/13836.jpg
同年，庞麦郎的签约公司也以私下接取演出，拒绝公司安排演艺活动等理由，将庞麦郎告上了法庭，虽然最终结果不了了之，可这意味着庞麦郎彻底与原公司决裂，就此失去了包装和外援。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260826_zhb_736_1/14240.jpg
也就在此时，庞麦郎与未来的经纪人“白晓”见面了。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260826_zhb_736_1/14585.jpg
庞麦郎一上来就给白晓出了个难题：他放不下“国际巨星”的面子，坚持要在西安市的圣朱雀体育场开演唱会。
白晓知道这是异想天开，他跑遍关系，最后庞麦郎也不得不妥协，在一家刚开张的小型剧场开办演唱会，为防止没有人来，原本预计售票的演唱会也改成了全场免费。
据白晓说，演唱会当天来了很多人，签名环节的热心粉丝排着长长的队伍，庞麦郎本人也特别开心。但事后统计，这个所谓的“很多人”事实上只有三百人，算上各种开支，这场演唱会净赔两万块。
https://img1.gamersky.com/image2026/08/20260826_zhb_736_1/15117.jpg
见演唱会行不通，白晓动用了全部人脉，为庞麦郎举办了LiveHouse全国巡演活动。2016年1月，巡演首站在杭州举办，当时现场气氛火热，‘帅呆了’、’实力唱将’的尖叫声此起彼伏，LiveHouse内到处都是快活的空气。
2016年上半年，靠着庞麦郎人气的余温和大力宣传，巡演的票房成绩不错，一个月最多可以赚20w。
白晓和庞麦郎都认为，这是他们苦尽甘来的开始，却没想到是结束。
长期脱离互联网，还一直都没有新的“神曲”出圈，庞麦郎的热度一直在走低，2016年下半年的巡演因此难以为继，票房从三位数下跌到了个位数，甚至出现了保安人数比观众还多的奇景，有的场次因为完全没有观众买票不得不取消。
可庞麦郎似乎还沉浸在他那“国际巨星”的幻梦中，他要求自己的演唱会必须是专场，不能有人与他同台；商演时不能播放广告，舞台上必须有八位舞伴，有的时候还必须指定外国模特参演......
在完全入不敷出的情况下，白晓只得靠着信用卡和撸网贷继续巡演，同时他也开始积极探求新的破局方法，比如参加当时的热门综艺节目，但被庞麦郎严词拒绝；还尝试过抖音直播带货滑板鞋，几乎无人问津，直播间稀少的弹幕几乎清一色的是谩骂和嘲讽。
没多久，庞麦郎的巡演彻底停摆，他本人从互联网上彻底消失了，这个早已被全网当成小丑的所谓“音乐家”貌似真的找厂上班去了。
2021年初，沉寂了数年的庞麦郎重新登上了微博热搜——据他的经纪人白晓在直播中透露，庞麦郎因为严重的精神分裂症，被送进了精神病院。
精神病
巡演停摆之后，失意的庞麦郎回到了陕西老家，在家里闭门不出，埋头写歌词，很少和家人对话，还经常情绪失控。
他时常怀疑母亲在自己的饭菜里下了毒，指责她是杀人犯；还因为和父母起了冲突，一度被抓进了派出所......他被连续三次送进了精神病院，就连最艰难时候不离不弃的前经纪人白晓都和他分道扬镳。
出院后的庞麦郎，依旧不愿从事普通工作，他坚持音乐创作，并在22年签约了一家新的传媒公司，重新在抖音开播带货，同时承接各种商演。每次庞麦郎在直播中开口唱歌的时候，同他搭档的女生都举着牌子憋笑，不知道是出于上头的要求还是因为庞麦郎的歌声实在太过难绷。
但很快，庞麦郎就因为直播效果太差被新公司抛弃，再一次在互联网上消失了，只有偶尔被抓拍到的零星走穴片段和户外直播切片，能证明庞麦郎依旧在从事音乐活动。
即使沦落到如今这步田地，在庞麦郎眼里，自己依然是走向国际的巨星，一直以来，他都拒绝承认自己在音乐事业上的失败，坚持为自己营造海外高知和曲高和寡的音乐艺术家的人设。
他时至今日都在坚持自己来自中国台湾省，曾在英国学习音乐，甚至曾在采访中公开不认自己的父母。
他的前经纪人白晓曾和他爆发争执，说他能不能真实点，庞麦郎则回答：如果他们知道自己只是个农村喂猪的，还会找我演出吗？
庞麦郎厌恶自己的农村出身，他因为出身问题屡屡碰壁，被人歧视。因《我的滑板鞋》一举成名后，他的厌恶又转化成了恐惧，他恐惧失去热度，为此无所不用其极，撒谎，伪装，佯装凶狠，甚至编造自己的人生。
他深陷在那个天王巨星的幻梦里，却完全忘记了自己创作的初心是那个活在自己歌词里的，抱着滑板鞋兴奋不已的少年。
如今，早已沦为大众眼里的丑角的庞麦郎，依然在承接着各种商演工作，创作新曲。数据显示，他的个人商演出场费在6w左右，基本算得上国内歌手的最低水平，因此有搞抽象的富哥专门请他上台表演，就是为了带人聚众赤石。
2025年4月，他发布了新曲《我的父亲是瓦匠》，重复的歌词和依旧同伴奏完全脱节的唱腔完全不堪入耳，不光如此，就算歌词存在大量的重复，庞麦郎却依然能够做到每句歌词一种不同的腔调，唱出了一种原始部落祭祀念咒的美。彼时因质量太差而遭到全网群嘲的中文版《Lemon》和“如何呢又能怎”见了估计都要甘拜下风。
小编坚持了1分42秒，你们也来试试吧
几乎同时，他重启了荒废多年的巡演，第一站定在贵阳，却只有九个人到场，首战失利，似乎他又要重蹈覆辙。

content.v: Since the full reveal of Total War: Warhammer's new Lords of the End Times expansion, the content is coming in thick and fast. Last week, Creative Assembly showed off Neferata, the incoming Free-LC lord, alongside the extremely fun-looking rework for the Vampire Counts . This week we're getting more information about the new end game crises.

The latest livestream went deep on Archaon's new Chaos Invasion endgame, Nagash's Great Ritual of Nagash, and the Skaven's Vermintide. We got to a rundown of each crisis, saw differently devastated world regions and special devastated battle maps, and even got an introduction to new End Times units.

Most notable for me, though, was the news that The Vermintide endgame features a rat counter that shows how many Skaven you still have left to kill. "You can see an estimated number of rats" says Mitch Heastie, Lead Game Designer on Total War: Warhammer, during the livestream. "It is based on the actual numbers, like roughly."

The counter on the stream (at 40:37) reads 165,000 RATS, who make up 60 Skaven armies you'll have to defeat. The Vermintide end game does sound fun, though. You'll have to destroy Skaven Under-Cities before they blow up your settlements with Doomspheres and quickly recapture territory, as the rat men will keep spawning armies otherwise. There are also new buildings to help deal with the menace, and it sounds like there's a narrative component, as each defeated army helps you uncover the Skaven's insidious plot.

By comparison, Nagash's end game is more focused on the climactic final battle. As the Black Pyramid slowly travels to Nagashizzar, you'll have to mitigate the Lord of Undeath's conquests and weaken him as much as possible for that final confrontation. And of course, there's Archaon's reworked Chaos Invasion , where you'll have to defeat his armies and fortresses to weaken his ward save before he destroys too much of the world. Otherwise he'll be functionally immortal. Easy enough.

I've got to say, all of these updates alongside the Lords of the End Times content have me very excited to play on September 24. With the news that anyone who buys one of the expansion lords gets access to Immortal Empires , it's also going to be one of the best times to start playing Total War: Warhammer as well.

items.title: Mega Man: Dual Override Feels Like a Perfect Entry Point Into the Series
items.summary: We played Mega Man: Dual Override, which is shaping up to be a perfect entry point into the series.

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/24/mega-man-preview-blog-1787579169458.jpg

My earliest video game memories are tied to the Blue Bomber. Barely four years old and playing through Mega Man 2 and 3 on the NES, I somehow made my way through their challenging levels. I won’t say that at that age I could comprehend the precision engineering behind their action-platforming, but I always knew there was something about those games that just felt fantastic. Fast forward 30 years, and I found myself sitting in Capcom’s offices feeling the same sensation. Mega Man: Dual Override understands that it's part of a series built firmly on its tight gameplay foundations, and from my brief time going hands-on with it, it’s looking like a worthy return for Dr Light’s most loyal creation.

As much as things change, they stay the same. Greeting me on the start game screen of Dual Override was the traditional grid of robot masters, all shrouded in mystery for this demo, apart from one: Twinkle Girl. Choosing the order you take on bosses is a key part of any Mega Man strategy, but while that decision was taken away from me for this small slice, another new dilemma was presented in its place. Before entering a stage, you’ll be offered one of three Chip Sets. These are:
Because I’m a stubborn bastard, I chose the latter.

Things didn’t start out too badly — each robot master’s area is made up of three stages, with the first of Twinkle Girl’s not giving me too many problems. A classic mix of precision platforming, dodging enemy projectiles, and firing upon Mets (the hard-hatted enemies who pop up and become vulnerable when you get close) makes up much of the industrial-looking level, and it really felt like reactivating a long-dormant part of my brain. That Mega Buster cannon arm still feels as good as it did decades ago.

Then came Big Press Don. Each stage has its own mini boss, and this giant, red, jet-packed lump of metal was my first real test. Thankfully, I still had a full tank of special ammo available to me, so I hopped into the air to reach Don’s vulnerable head and barraged him with the whole nine yards. I don’t know what other Robot Master this skill is borrowed from — as is Mega Man tradition, you take on the skills of your fallen foes — but it dressed me in a turquoise outfit with an orange-visored helmet alongside a “gun” that propelled me forward in a powerful dash. It’s safe to say Don didn’t like it, as a few hits drained his health bar in seconds. It’s hard to make definitive calls on strategy in a demo as short as this, but I’m guessing this dash weapon was his weakness; after all, finding the most efficient weapons to take on each big enemy, and the order to take them on, has long been the key to solving the overall Mega Man puzzle.

And so onto the second stage I went, and deeper into the giant robot exhibit that Twinkle Girl had decided to call home. I definitely felt the difficulty creep up a little here, with the platforming in particular increasing in complexity. More moving lifts entered the fray as timing jumps became all the more crucial, especially when leaping over firework cannons that would erupt their damaging sparkles in intermittent bursts.

But the biggest surprise came at the end of these few minutes of platforming when I entered the next boss room. Upon being locked in, the tech-filled room shifted into an augmented reality amongst the stars. But that was only the first unexpected thing to happen. That’s because this new space is home to a copy of Astro Man, one of Mega Man 8’s robot masters. This returning foe packs the same moveset as he did on the original PlayStation, complete with swooping lunges, annoying twin spheres that spin around him, and raining green meteors that deal big damage if you mistime your approach. It’s a shinier version of the 30-year-old fight, but I can’t help but feel slightly disappointed that no new attacks or quirks have seemingly been included. It would be nice to see Dual Override referencing the past while remixing it, rather than simply recreating old memories.

On one hand, I enjoyed fighting him again. But on the other, it’s also where my earlier hubris caught up with me. With neither of the more beneficial chip sets selected at the start of my run, I was finding him a real challenge to take down. Rush simply wasn’t going to help me here. And so, knowing my demo time was limited, I finally gave in, restarting the stage with the energy barrier shield equipped. Smart employment of this, plus knowing when to enter the titular Override mode to increase my damage output, soon made quick work of him. Dual Override is also very kind in granting you a checkpoint just outside the boss room, letting you get back into the action within a few seconds of defeat – a “modern” concession that classic Mega Man would never offer.

Peculiarly, I found that second stage to be the toughest part of my demo, with the final section providing less of a challenge. Perhaps this is because it played to my skill set better. I like front-foot, aggressive battles, and that is exactly what my showdown with Twinkle Girl gave me. From first shot to last, our fight lasted less than a minute due to her glass-cannon nature. She’s deadly, but seemed to be more vulnerable to my attacks, especially the aforementioned special weapon. She dashes quickly across the screen, plummets downwards like a furious phoenix, and unleashes starbursts of colourful fireworks. Weave in and out of these deadly displays, and she’s yours for the taking, her weapon yours. Frustratingly, though, I didn't get to see what her armament is called, or get to try it out for myself. I appreciate the variety I’ve already seen in Dual Override’s boss battles, though, and look forward to seeing what else awaits further down the road.

This is the first mainline Mega Man game in almost a decade, so Capcom has had plenty of time to think about what it wants to do with the series. Some things are a constant — precision platforming, tight fights, and the vibrant, animated stages they take place on, soundtracked by toe-tapping electronic tunes — but there’s enough new here to ensure it feels like a Mega Man for the 2020s. It’s too early to see if these new optional chip sets, override mode, and multi-stage Robot Master encounters with increased checkpointing will be an overall positive — but if nothing else, they certainly signal the developer's aim to make this entry more approachable. I remain hopeful, though. There’s still plenty of challenge to be found here, and I had a lot of fun returning to Mega Man with Dual Override. If these tweaks mean a lot more people can set foot in a series that once offered me a gateway into video games, then I’ll be more than happy.

Simon Cardy is a Senior Editor at IGN who can mainly be found skulking around open world games, indulging in Korean cinema, or despairing at the state of Tottenham Hotspur and the New York Jets. Follow him on Bluesky at @cardy.bsky.social .

https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/07/11/origin_202607111028562943.gif
通过任务奖励与战斗成长，不断解锁装备升级，打造属于自己的末日战车。任务期间还将获得随机的强化和地图，将给你带来截然不同的战斗体验和成长路线。
当世界已经被丧尸感染化作废土，我们依旧向灾难源头发起远征！
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/07/11/origin_202607111029128847.gif
你需要探索危险区域、搜刮资源、挑战变异怪物，并逐步深入这场灾难的源头。从破败工厂到感染城区，随着地图深入，遭遇各式各样的特殊事件与闯入高风险区域。你收集到的每一份资源，都能进一步强化装备与角色成长；但与此同时，更加恐怖的尸潮与更加强大的特殊感染体头目，也会不断逼近。
前往Steam商店页面，驾驶你的末日战车，开启一场酣畅淋漓的丧尸收割之旅。8折优惠限时进行中，废土见！

items.title: OLED gaming monitors have finally gotten so good that a Counter-Strike 2 tournament is using one
items.summary: The Asus ROG Swift OLED PG259QWS Ace is the first OLED to make it into a CS2 Major.

content.v: I've been watching the ascent of OLED with a very keen eye, primarily because as a Counter-Strike 2 gamer, I know just how promising OLEDs will be for competitive gaming. And now it seems we're at the point where they've gotten good enough in specific ways to be the official panel tech of choice in an official CS2 Major tournament.

Asus' new monitor, the ROG Swift OLED PG259QWS Ace , is going to be the official monitor of the 2026 PGL CS2 major . It's a glossy tandem WOLED with a response time of 0.02 ms (GTG), which is low even for OLED.

More relevant here, though, is that it's a 720 Hz, 24.5-inch panel. We've seen high refresh rate OLEDs before, but most of these (A) are 27-inch or bigger, and (B) only achieve their high refresh rates when dropped to 720p. Getting up to 1080p is ideal for pro gaming, especially in CS2, where some will want to stretch a 4:3 resolution, and 24/25-inch monitors are preferred.

It might seem silly to some, but I've tested some pro-level monitors and can confirm that 24/25-inch monitors can make playing CS2 a little more comfortable, allowing you to see the entire game scene without squinting in a way that pushing a 27-inch monitor further away somehow doesn't quite replicate. I did also find in that testing that there are diminishing returns to higher refresh rates above about 360 Hz, but hey, I'm not a pro. I have no doubt they can make use of those extra returns, diminishing as they are.

All this is to say, the fact that we've now got a 24.5-inch OLED reaching up to 720 Hz is really going to give TN panels like those from Zowie a run for their money. Especially given OLEDs don't need to use backlight strobing to reduce motion blur because their pixels already change incredibly quickly. And, of course, given they look gorgeous.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/y8h3tWUNxQmrHZQkUvxMGK.jpg

It seems PGL (the tournament organiser) agrees. According to Asus, PGL CEO Silviu Stroie remarked: "The first OLED Major on the fastest OLED ever made—it’s a new generation of competitive Counter-Strike."

And you know what? I actually don't doubt it. CS2 tournies have been run on TNs for, well, forever. And pros have been reluctant to switch away in part for this reason: it's best to practice on the monitors you'll be using in tournaments. So if tournies start switching over to OLED, this could indeed be the start of a new generation of pro gaming, at least as far as monitors are concerned.

And we couldn't really ask for a better kind of gear for such a change to happen to than the monitor. I love writing about monitors these days, as they're one bit of PC gaming kit that hasn't felt the pricing bite of the global memory shortage .

It also helps that technologies seem to be not only improving but also actually getting cheaper , and nothing highlights that more than the wonderful world of OLEDs— $299 for a 1440p, 240 Hz panel , anyone?

items.title: Round Up: Gamescom Opening Night Live 2026 - Every Switch 1 & 2 Announcement & Trailer
items.summary: The Witcher 3! LEGO Skylines! Mewgenics! Gamescom Opening Night Live 2026 has now wrapped up after roughly 2 h

others.title: Gamescom Opening Night Live 2026: All The Biggest Announcements, Games, And Trailers

content.v: Gamescom Opening Night Live is here, and once again, we're expecting a bumper night full of new game reveals, gameplay deep-dives, and more from Geoff Keighley's second big show of the year. As usual, we'll be keeping tabs on the event--and the preshow hosted by Kyle Bosman that starts at 10:30 AM PT / 1:30 PM ET--so if you don't have time to sit down for all of the announcements, you can check back here for updates on all the big announcements.

Taking place from the Gamescom showfloor, Gamescom Opening Night Live kicks off at 11 AM PT / 2 PM ET, and Keighley has already dropped a few big game names for this year's edition. Gears of War: E-Day, Metro 2039, and Final Fantasy 7 Revelation are some of the biggest games being shown off, and they'll be joined by new looks at Tides of Annihilation, Ananta, Game of Thrones: War for Westeros, Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons, and The Witcher 3: Songs of the Past.
Worms: Galactic Tactics
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Worms.jpg?w=636

And we're kicking things off with the preshow! Presented by the Final Bosman himself, our first trailer is for a new Worms tactics game that takes a page from the XCOM playbook. It looks like the original Worms is also coming back in some form.
Train Sim World 7
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Train.jpg?w=636
The next chapter in the longrunning Train Sim World series launches on September 15.
Roller Coaster Tycoon Wonderworks
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Rollercoaster-tycoon.jpg?w=636
Think you have what it takes to run the ultimate theme park? You can put your skills to the test when Roller Coaster Tycoon Wonderworks launches in early access soon.
Animo
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Animo.jpg?w=636
Animo looks like it might be getting a visit from The Pokemon Company soon, but until then, the new trailer for the game showed off plenty of cute critters battling each other and one titanic dragon.
Genigods: Nezha
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Genigods.jpg?w=636
An ARPG rooted in ancient Chinese creation mythology, players will take on titanic monsters as the Spirit Pearl, the first being forged by the Goddess of Creation Nüwa.
Perceptum
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Perceptum.jpg?w=636
Need some horror that's all about things that go bump in the night? Perceptum looks like it'll scratch that itch when it launches in 2027.
Acornia: Mirror Worlds
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/cornia.jpg?w=636
This bake-and-brawl management adventure game from Splashteam continues to look adorable, and it's out next year.
Valor Mortis
One more trailer for the upcoming first-person souls-like Valor Mortis from Ghostrunner Studio One More Level, which launches on October 13 for PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S.
TankRat
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/TankRat.jpg?w=636
We've got a release date for TankRat, where you'll battle swarms of corrupted mech-monsters from your heavily armed vehicle. It's out on January 17, 2027.
Humankind 2
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Humankind-2.jpg?w=636
The sequel to 2021's Humankind aims to improve on the 4X strategy formula, and once again, players can guide their nation through various eras of human history. It'll be coming to PC in 2027.
Murals

What do centuries-old fables like The Little Mermaid, Rapunzel, and Hansel & Gretel all have in common? Besides the original fiction being nightmare fuel, they're also all featured in Murals, an original IP from Disney Illusion Island developer Dlala Studios. The isometric action-adventure game is set across multiple famous fairy tales, and players will control a nameless hero who must brave dark, twisted takes on these beloved stories.
Age Twisters
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Age-Twisters.jpg?w=636
Age Twisters is a two-player co-op narrative adventure game, where you'll play as a grandfather and granddaughter who team up to solve puzzles. It looks adorable, but it has no release date yet.
Onimusha: Way of the Sword
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/original/123/1239113/4513336-onimusha.jpg?w=636

In case you missed it, there's a demo out there for Onimusha: Way of the Sword. And if you've already played it? Then it's time to boot it up again, as Capcom has added more content to this early--and free--slice of the game.
Mariachi Legends
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Mariachi-Legends.jpg?w=636
I didn't have a Mexican vampire metroidvania on my Gamescom bingo card, but Mariachi Legends is scratching an itch for that very specific scratch I didn't know I had. It launches in April 2027.
Elta: Defy All Gods

Get ready to brawl your way out of corrupted worlds in Elta: Defy All Gods. You've also got an adorable dragon-god companion, free-form melee combat, and fluid platforming, so this might be worth keeping an eye on.
Two hours of game trailers
Two whole hours! We hope you don't need the loo for a while.
Nodus Fall

HoyoVerse made a name for itself with anime-inspired live-service games, but for its next title? It looks like the developer is taking on Elden Ring developer From Software with a high fantasy adventure that looks gorgeous. Called Nodus Fall, players take on the role of a Weaver in this co-op action game.
Rainbow Six Tactics

It's the first brand-new Rainbow Six game in many years! Rainbow Six Tactics. Featuring 15 unique Operators, players will take part in missions across the globe in this XCOM-inspired title. It's out in 2027.
Gears of War: E-Day

After a fun weekend in the Gears of War: E-Day multiplayer beta, the focus is on the story with this new trailer for the game. It's the darkest hour for humanity as Emergence Day leaves cities across Sera ruined, but it looks like humanity isn't ready to go down without a fight. Gears of War: E-Day launches on October 6.
Ananta

NetEase's free-to-play GTA-meets-Spider-Man game Ananta is all about keeping the peace and building a social media empire. It looks wonderfully ridiculous, and it launches on January 15, 2027, for PC and PS5.
Silent Hill Townfall

In case the next few months don't look busy enough, you can try out some small-town Scottish horror in Silent Hill Townfall. The new trailer showed off more of the spooky game in action, and it's the first Silent Hill to be played from a first-person perspective. It's out on September 24.
Resonance: A Plague Tale
The next Plague Tale game is also out soon, and instead of having too many rats, it focuses on puzzles, exploration, and combat.
Sea Remnants
A fresh look at Sea of Remnants next, a pirate-themed RPG with some stylish visuals. I can't say I'm too big a fan of the trailer's use of cheesy country music, though.

items.title: 《巫师3》新DLC剧情：好兄弟丹德里恩为核心
items.summary: 《巫师3：狂猎》全新DLC，其核心人物正是杰洛特的老朋友——吟游诗人丹德里恩。

content.v: https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608261823276860.png
《巫师3：狂猎》的全新资料片《旧时曲》而据多家媒体及参与闭门演示的博主透露，这部时隔近十年推出的全新DLC，其核心人物正是杰洛特的老朋友——吟游诗人丹德里恩。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608261823332439.png
资料片的故事将以杰洛特寻找失踪的丹德里恩为起点，首次带领玩家踏入吟游诗人的家族领地——莱顿（Letten）。这片位于瑞达尼亚北部、从未被战争触及的隐秘山谷，正是丹德里恩的故乡。玩家将在此探索其家族庄园，并遇见丹德里恩的表亲及一位性情暴躁的老妇人。本次DLC被定位为聚焦杰洛特与丹德里恩“兄弟情谊”的“丹德里恩中心”扩展，其剧情风格被描述为与《石之心》的叙事方向相近。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608261823342045.png
需要说明的是，重制版和资料片《旧时曲》是两个不同的项目。《巫师3：狂猎 重制版》定于2026年9月29日上线，所有已拥有原版游戏的玩家均可免费升级；而本次公布的核心是全新资料片《旧时曲》，该内容将在后续以付费DLC形式推出。

items.title: 中世纪魅魔榨汁机！和兄弟一起榨个爽
items.summary: 多人合伙榨果汁！中世纪模拟经营《一起来榨大果汁》

content.v: 也许不是口渴的人，而是那个想补充水分、改善状态，甚至对果汁功效有一堆要求的挑剔村民。
中世纪经营模拟游戏《一起来榨大果汁》目前已在 Steam 开放试玩 Demo，并支持简体中文。游戏计划于 2026 年 9 月正式推出。玩家将从一间简陋的小作坊起步，采购原料、研究配方、亲手榨汁，再跑遍村庄寻找客人；等赚到第一桶金后，还能购置机器、雇佣员工、扩建店铺，把最初什么都要自己干的小生意，一步步做成自动运转的果汁产业。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608261841283013.png
APP用户【一键加入愿望单】
《 一起来榨大果汁 》宣传片：
《一起来榨大果汁》中，可用于制作饮品的不只有常见水果。
水果、蔬菜、鲜花、香料、草药、糖、牛奶、酸奶等不同材料都能加入配方，而不同原料带来的也不仅是味道变化，还会赋予果汁各种不同效果。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608261841355414.png
村庄里的居民各有自己的需求。玩家需要认识他们、了解他们想要什么，再根据手中的材料调整配方，把合适的果汁送到合适的人手中。
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/origin_202608261841423991.gif
于是，制作果汁并不是简单照着固定菜单重复生产，而是围绕“原料—功效—客人需求”不断寻找更合适的搭配。
随着认识的村民越来越多，掌握的配方越来越丰富，原本只会制作几杯基础果汁的小店，也会慢慢拥有越来越稳定的熟客。
创业初期，所谓“果汁店老板”，基本意味着所有事情都得自己做。
购买原料、操作机器、研究配方、寻找顾客、送货收钱……店里大大小小的工作，全都得亲自上手。
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/origin_202608261841512113.gif
但赚来的钱可以继续投入生意。随着经营推进，玩家能够购置新的加工设备，并雇佣售货员、洗碗工、榨汁工、调配员、采购员等不同员工，把原本压在自己身上的工作逐渐拆分出去。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608261842019343.png
与此同时，爷爷还会通过书信送来新的机器设计图。原本只有几件简单工具的小作坊，会逐渐被各种加工和生产设备填满，一套属于自己的果汁生产流程也随之成型。
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/origin_202608261842082766.gif
从前期亲手切水果、榨果汁、满村跑腿，到后期看着员工和机器各司其职，《一起来榨大果汁》的经营成长，也体现在这种从“什么都自己干”到“终于可以当老板”的变化里。
当一个村子的生意已经满足不了你，还可以继续前往新的区域，租下新的经营场所，把果汁卖到更多地方。
如果觉得一个人又采购、又生产、又送货实在太忙，《一起来榨大果汁》也支持多人在线合作。
和朋友一起经营时，可以真正给店铺做些分工：一个人出去采购和寻找顾客，另一个留在店里处理生产；或者两个人一起研究怎样安排机器和流程，把订单做得更快。
当然，也可能变成两个人同时站在店里，最后谁都忘了杯子还没洗。
无论选择单人慢慢经营，还是叫上朋友一起折腾，从亲手榨出的第一杯果汁，到机器、员工和新店铺逐渐铺开，《一起来榨大果汁》都围绕着一件事情展开——想办法让越来越多的中世纪村民喝上真正适合他们的那一杯果汁。
https://imggif.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/origin_202608261842172905.gif
《一起来榨大果汁》目前已在 Steam 开放简体中文 Demo。
现在即可前往 Steam 免费试玩，并将《一起来榨大果汁》加入愿望单。准备好原料，下一位带着奇怪需求找上门来的村民，可能就在路上！

items.title: 国产内存爆发！长鑫DDR5颗粒性能实测 与海力士旗舰没差
items.summary: 据B站UP主芝士华莱士的最新实测，国产长鑫存储颗粒已能稳定运行在DDR5-8000频率，且在部分生产力及游戏测试中，其性能表现已与海外主流的海力士新旗舰M-die方案高度接近。 此次测试硬件平台采用英特尔酷睿Ultra

content.v: 据B站UP主芝士华莱士的最新实测，国产长鑫存储颗粒已能稳定运行在DDR5-8000频率，且在部分生产力及游戏测试中，其性能表现已与海外主流的海力士新旗舰M-die方案高度接近。
此次测试硬件平台采用英特尔酷睿Ultra 7 270K Plus处理器，搭配微星Z890M GAMING PLUS WIFI主板，显卡选用七彩虹GeForce RTX 5080 Ultra WOC，并由1200W大功率电源驱动。
参与对比的内存分别为采用长鑫颗粒的雷克沙THOR RGB(原始规格7200MT/s CL38)和采用海力士颗粒的光威神武(原始规格6800MT/s CL34)，两款内存均超频至8000MT/s开展对比。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260826/1787729993_864089.jpg
在频率提升至8000MT/s后，长鑫方案的时序达到了CL40-52-52-128，海力士方案则采用了更紧的CL36-48-48-96。
基准测试显示，长鑫颗粒在8000MT/s下的内存读取带宽约为123.32GB/s，延迟为76.1ns，海力士方案读取带宽约为124.68GB/s，延迟为72.2ns。
两者带宽表现基本处于同一水平，海力士凭借更收紧的时序，在内存延迟方面取得领先。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260826/1787729993_786392.jpg
在Geekbench 6测试中，长鑫8000MT/s方案获得24576分，与海力士同频率方案的24790分相比，差距仅为0.86%左右。
游戏性能上，在1080P分辨率测试中，在《彩虹六号：围攻X》中，两套8000MT/s内存的平均帧数仅相差5帧，差距不到1%。而在《刺客信条：黑旗重制版》中，两者的帧数表现基本处于同一水平线。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260826/1787729993_103556.jpg
除此之外，在《使命召唤21》和《极限竞速：地平线5》等大作中，两套高频方案的帧数表现几乎完全一致，差距不足1FPS。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

有玩家表示，新Demo的难度有所提升，但整体依旧比较简单，不过战斗系统本身相当不错，“战斗得越多，我就越喜欢”，同时还特别称赞了特殊挑战内容，认为非常有趣。
也有玩家给出了截然不同的评价。他认为敌人的表现依然比较无聊，攻击方式也显得比较敷衍，希望敌人能够变得更加具有攻击性。“敌人需要更加主动地进攻。”该玩家甚至表示，也许这款游戏就是不适合自己。

值得一提的是，还有玩家被官方这次更新Demo的操作惊到了，直接表示：“我从来没见过一个Demo还能追加这么多内容，太棒了。”

items.title: PS5老玩家对索尼大失所望：想卖掉PS5换Steam主机

content.v: 由你来说： PS5世代过半，独占阵容疲软、索尼强推数字版取消实体盘、游戏定价越来越离谱——一位忠实PlayStation玩家在Reddit发帖，认真考虑卖掉自己的PS5，换一台Valve的Steam Machine。他的理由是：Steam游戏库更大、折扣更狠、Valve向来更照顾玩家感受，而且他本来就是PC玩家。你觉得他的选择合理吗？
近日，Reddit用户Nebulous-8发帖称，自己对PS5这一代越来越失望——独占阵容不够强、索尼转向全数字版让他作为实体收藏家的热情被浇灭。他手里有一台Steam Deck，对Valve的玩家友好策略和Steam的折扣力度非常认可，正在考虑卖掉PS5换一台Steam Machine，构建以Steam为核心的游戏生态。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608261805004872.png

支持换机的玩家认为，Steam Machine本质上是一台PC，比主机灵活得多。有用户指出：“如果你想要一台PC，Steam Machine比主机好得多；如果你只是想要一台游戏主机，PS5更好。”还有玩家强调Steam Machine可以安装Steam、EA、Epic、Xbox等多个启动器，还能模拟老主机游戏，“PS5能做的它都能做，还能做更多。”

items.title: Fable: After Watching a Full Quest, I Couldn’t Be More Excited to Play It | gamescom 2026
items.summary: Beer, swearing, and aggressive strangers. I feel at home. After watching a full quest from Fable, I couldn't b

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/08/26/fable-preview-blog-1787737593256.jpg
Key Preview Takeaways:

Beer, swearing, and aggressive strangers. Just your average Thursday night in a North London pub. Turns out fantasy isn’t too far from reality, though, with a stroll around Fable delivering the exact same ingredients for an eventful afternoon. A hands-off presentation at gamescom 2026 gave me new insight into developer Playground Games’ Albion and the stories taking place in it. Here, I’ll walk you through everything that was shown, ahead of me going hands-on with Fable and its combat systems later — stay tuned for my impressions of that very soon. For now, it’s time to take a trip through Bowerstone and see what a full quest brings with it.

For those uninitiated in the original Fable trilogy, Bowerstone is the capital of the fantasy world of Albion, and it’s never looked better than it does here. At the beginning of my roughly 15-minute live gameplay demo, our hero, a young woman with a sword on her back, rode up to the portcullis of the looming city. What could be an intimidating sight quickly turned into one of awe, though, with its central keep towering over crooked, smaller buildings that stack up towards it. There’s a pleasing off-kilterness to the town, reflecting the imbalance in its world as good struggles to outweigh evil. The askew rooftops and twisty brickwork marry beautifully with the winding nature of the city’s streets and the uneven cobblestones that make them. It all makes this world feel entirely handcrafted and believably constructed by the people that live there, rather than a dull geometric pattern laid down by an unimaginative city planner.

It’s not just a sight to behold, though, but a city full of purpose. Over 30 businesses are dotted across it, from hairdressers to clothes shops to tattoo parlours. Playground really wants you to create a character entirely in your own image, and make them feel as married to the world you walk them through as possible. Speaking of marriage, our first stop in Bowerstone takes us to the hero’s family home — a cosy, well-kept cottage warmed by a roaring fireplace. Waiting for us are our daughter, Daisy, and spouse, Elliott. The love between him and our hero is still strong, it seems – as she walks away from him, he can’t help but remark, “Ooph, so glad I married all of that”. Steady on, Elliott, we’ve got a village to save.

Briar Hill is that village, and the crux of Fable’s main story. A mysterious red-cloaked figure called Isabel has turned the people of our hometown to stone, and it's up to us to reanimate them. This quest we’re on now seems fairly early on in the plot, and has taken us to the capital to gain access to the Heroes Guild. A previous mission has popped the key to the Guild’s headquarters in our inventory, and so we stroll up to the huge doors with ease. Again, both the exterior and interior architecture and art design on show are wonderful, with a delightful mix of grandeur and deliberate rough edges on show.

Sitting inside the guild is Humphry the Golden, a legendary figure in Albion folklore who appears to have seen better days. Played by Peep Show’s Super Hans supremo, Matt King, he cuts the figure of a bedraggled alcoholic, slumped in a large chair in the darkness. Never meet your heroes has never proved a truer phrase. Proving my point, in a stupor, he asks for a large beer, and we’re presented with our first choice — Playground promises Fable is packed full of both big and small decisions that will impact everything from minor character relationships to major story moments. Do you give Humphry the tankard full of hoppy goodness, or throw it over him in an attempt to wake him up? The latter is chosen, and a pop-up appears on the left of the screen letting us know that he now thinks we’re an arsehole.

Nonetheless, Humphry needs our help. In debt and on the cusp of being evicted, in order to gain his guidance, we’ll need to dig him out of a hole. It turns out that this once-respected hero gambled away the ownership rights of the guild and lost them to Slick Ronnie, a local Bowerstone gang leader. So, it’s now our job to get them back. It doesn’t take us long to get in trouble with this gang, either. One step back onto the streets and we’re faced with a trio of Ronnie’s lackeys who are bothering Billie, described by Playground as a “part-time playwright, full-time orphan.” Dialogue options are given, and an attempt to defuse the situation is made. Unfortunately, for them, violence is deemed necessary.

It’s the first opportunity for us to get a proper look at Fable’s combat, and I’m impressed. It’s always difficult to know how good a game’s action is until you get your hands on it yourself — something I’ll be doing in mere hours — but it certainly looks slick. Sweeping sword slashes are executed. A bow and arrow is fired satisfyingly with a ping into someone's head. A long electric whip is conjured and sent crashing down onto the group. A fireball is sculpted from our hero’s palms and sent blazing into a chest containing a now-unbeating heart. The flexibility on show is great to see, and it appears this won’t be an RPG that restricts your combat options depending on a strict class structure

That encounter earns us a skill point, and a fairly extensive skill tree is flashed up on screen and then closed before I have time to study it in any depth. However, I did see what the skill point was spent on: magical blades, a spell any Fable veteran will no doubt fondly remember. We’ll see in action shortly.

First, it’s time to head to a more down-on-its-luck part of town where Slick Ronnie’s hideout can be found. Of course, the trail takes us to a pub. The Poor House is Ronnie’s chosen watering hole, and after talking to its clientele, it becomes apparent we need access to the back area of the establishment. There are multiple ways in, but we choose the easy road and pay for entry to save time.

Once through the door, we find ourselves faced with another lock we don’t have the key for. This door is unguarded, however, so we put our trusty lockpicking skills to the test and gain swift entry. There’s no Fallout-esque tumbler-rotating minigame to play here, just a simple hold of a button instead. Ronnie’s office waits on the other side, and the deeds to the guild are there to be plundered. Just walking away would be far too simple, though, wouldn’t it? On the way out, Ronnie isn’t very happy to see us, and a quick attempt to bluff her by saying we wandered into this restricted area after a few too many drinks doesn’t go down well. It’s time to fight again, and the perfect opportunity for those magical blades to see some action.

Upon triggering the attack, three glowing blue swords float above our heads before darting towards an enemy each – it’s very much the spell you remember, and a good indicator that Playground has no intention of abandoning Fable’s history. It appears to be a great crowd control tool when surrounded by multiple attackers, as we are here. A follow-up arrow to one of their knees makes one satisfyingly stumble as they react to the target damage, and then met with the pointed end of our sword. Things then get a little trickier here, as a bulky brute wielding a two-handed axe enters the fight. It’s instantly noticeable how many more hits he can take, so instead it seems wise to focus on building up his stagger bar through sustained attacks so a big damage window opens. Again, I’m impressed by the fluidity of the action.

items.title: 《地铁2039》不再延续中立叙事 主角将有更明确立场
items.summary: 在近日公开的深度访谈中，乌克兰开发商4A Games披露了《地铁2039》开发理念的根本性转变。这款系列新作不再延续以往“预防战争”的灰色道德叙事，转而直面“战争的代价”，首次以更鲜明的立场探讨极权、压迫与自由的主题。执

content.v: 在近日公开的深度访谈中，乌克兰开发商4A Games披露了《地铁2039》开发理念的根本性转变。这款系列新作不再延续以往“预防战争”的灰色道德叙事，转而直面“战争的代价”，首次以更鲜明的立场探讨极权、压迫与自由的主题。执行制作人Jon Bloch表示，团队在过去数年间身处极为艰难的环境，这种现实不可避免地重塑了游戏的灵魂。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260826/1787737955_393510_jpg_r.jpg
Bloch指出，系列前作在道德层面保持开放性与灰色地带，但如今的创作视角已发生位移。“当故事探讨威权政权的扩张与集权时——其中没有任何美好可言，只有纯粹的恶。因此过去的灰色道德需要变得更分明、更清晰。”联合创意总监Pawel Ulmer补充道：“《地铁》从来就是关于战争崇拜、关于牺牲、关于他人野心代价的作品，只是如今它的本质离现实越来越近了。”
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260826/1787737972_506870_jpg_r.jpg
为实现这一转变，《地铁2039》首次为系列加入了全程配音的主角“陌生人”——一位不情愿地重返莫斯科地下隧道、面对新威胁的角色。地下社会已在名为“新帝国”的极权旗帜下形成统一阵营，由系列首作中曾出现的猎人领导，他不惜一切代价扫除障碍。
Bloch解释，有声主角的引入是为了让本作的表达更为直接。编剧团队包括系列原著作者、知名俄罗斯作家德米特里·格鲁霍夫斯基，意图让玩家深刻理解主角在遭遇“人性至暗”时的立场与抉择。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260826/1787737979_465141_jpg_r.jpg
在极为艰难的外部条件下，开发团队坚持工作。Ulmer形容“钻石在压力下形成”，并表示团队“把所有的消极与攻击性都以好的方式投入到了产品之中”，相信最终成品将忠实反映他们的经历。Bloch则感慨，团队如今面临的挑战“即便过一百万年也绝不会想到需要去解决”。
据外媒的短篇幅试玩体验，本作在射击手感、画面表现及故事深度上均展现高水准。令人窒息的幽闭感与危机感使前作相比之下都显得“近乎轻松”。但在末日世界中，仍有挣扎求生的家庭营造温暖瞬间的动人片段——昏暗居所里透出的团结与倔强，传递出微弱却坚定的人性光芒。
《地铁2039》预计于今年冬季发售。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

items.title: 《SILENT HILL: Townfall》公开主要英语配音阵容
items.summary: KONAMI释出最新gamescom Opening Night Live宣传影片，理查(Terry O'Quinn饰)与多种怪物样貌首度公开2026年8月26日-Konami Digital Entertainment

content.v: https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20260826/1787738438_333959.png
KONAMI释出最新gamescom Opening Night Live宣传影片，
理查(Terry O'Quinn饰)与多种怪物样貌首度公开
2026年8月26日-Konami Digital Entertainment Limited (KONAMI) 今日于gamescom Opening Night Live首播最新宣传影片，并公开《SILENT HILL: Townfall》主要角色演出阵容。
演出《LOST档案》及《阴尸路：生存者》的艾美奖(Emmy® Award)得主Terry O'Quinn于本作中饰演理查，这位将赛门找回圣爱蜜莉亚的神秘人物，揭开《SILENT HILL: Townfall》一连串事件的序幕。随着赛门的旅程推进，理查与小镇及其动荡过往之间的关联，也渐渐变得难以忽视。
曾演出《奥德赛》、《它：欢迎来到德利镇》及《三体》的Jovan Adepo饰演被找回到这座位于苏格兰偏远地区的聚落，好让“错误回到正轨”的主角赛门·奥戴尔。称为CRTV的神秘掌上电视接收难以解读的讯息，以及自己几乎遗忘的片段过去，醒来时几乎毫无头绪的赛门，很快便被卷入这充满谜团的旅程。
曾参与游戏《Observation》演出的Kezia Burrows，饰演富有同情心的护理师柔伊(Zoe)。穿越CRTV层层噪声传来她的声音，催促赛门“回到她身边”。由于无法对需要帮助的人视而不见，柔伊深陷于圣爱蜜莉亚居民的生活与形塑小镇风貌的种种事件之中。
最新宣传影片也揭露等著赛门的骇人威胁，包括穷追不舍的新怪物，还有令人不安的诡异景象，暗示潜藏于圣爱蜜莉亚表象之下的黑暗真相。
《SILENT HILL》系列的最新篇章，《SILENT HILL: Townfall》忠于长久以来围绕神秘、悲剧与失落等系列核心主题，同时也为心理恐怖体验带来崭新诠释。
本作采第一人称视角进行。玩家将扮演赛门，在包括用于接收不稳定讯号的掌上电视CRTV等有限的武器与工具支援下，探索、躲避并设法生存。逃避追击令人屏息的过程，紧张激烈的战斗节奏则，推进剧情的解谜，逐步揭露无法始终被埋没的真相。
《SILENT HILL: Townfall》预定于2026年9月24日在PlayStation®5、Steam®、Epic Games Store等平台推出，现已开放预购。更多请参阅官方網站。

items.title: 中元已近，黑暗降临。卡牌战斗游戏《恶魔召唤》正式加入机核发行，开启全新篇章
items.summary: 朋友们好，非常高兴能与大家分享一个好消息！由伏特加加独立开发的暗黑卡牌战斗游戏——《恶魔召唤》(Evocation) 正式宣布与机核发行 GCORES PUBLISHING 达成发行合作。本作将新颖的“法阵绘制”连结玩法

content.v: 朋友们好，非常高兴能与大家分享一个好消息！由伏特加加独立开发的暗黑卡牌战斗游戏——《恶魔召唤》(Evocation) 正式宣布与机核发行 GCORES PUBLISHING 达成发行合作。本作将新颖的“法阵绘制”连结玩法与极具质感的古典暗黑美学相融合，致力于为您呈现一场诡谲的策略博弈。 目前游戏的免费 Demo 已上线，并限时开启 PVE 新角色与 PVP 全卡池测试，诚邀各位加入官方群获取试玩资格，体验绘制法阵与驱使恶魔的乐趣！
https://image.gcores.com/3b925fe1906911d9effec9c984c81d2b-2560-1440.png
绘制法阵，召唤恶魔
《恶魔召唤》不同于传统卡牌战斗游戏的常规出牌逻辑，在游戏中，你的牌库被分散放置在六个节点上，卡牌不再是被直接打出，而是通过绘制法阵将其“连接”以进行仪式。不同图形的法阵会触发不同的神秘效果。
https://image.gcores.com/513670a506c50ad2e71a1d1bb669c0fa-1919-1079.png
作为所罗门王的后裔，你可以通过仪式积攒能量，召唤强大的恶魔为你作战；若战胜首领，更能将其献祭给恶魔，实现零能量召唤。此外，游戏用灵活的“装备-药膏”系统取代了传统的遗物，你可以自由穿搭、涂抹药膏，构筑与自己卡组适配的装备，以应对不同的强敌。
https://image.gcores.com/3041dd98d59cb048fc23a1cf8617a682-1920-1080.gif
踏上残酷的净化之旅
圣城被破，信仰被禁。在完整版游戏中，你将扮演多位背景迥异的角色踏上净化与朝圣之路：试图用祖先秘术夺回统治的“后裔”、降下神罚又执行慈悲的天使“代行者”，以及生命流逝却极度狂热的异界“旅人”等等 。
https://image.gcores.com/e04c41591709a86e5132293f95fab7ac-2560-1440.png
游戏拥有极高的构筑深度，完整版包含3个初始牌库、300多张卡牌与40种独特的敌人。经过深度设计的卡池让每一次肉鸽冒险都充满惊喜，绝不仅限于单一的套路。
https://image.gcores.com/7ea553e79e8e242e4b99551e0c3d785e-1920-1080.gif
共享法阵 PVP 模式
《恶魔召唤》不仅拥有扎实的PVE内容，还将在未来提供交互性极强的线上PVP模式。对局中，双方玩家将共用中央的核心法阵，牌库分散在各自一侧的三个节点上。最大的机制变动在于：你可以直接将对手的卡牌用于自己的仪式。这种抢夺和利用双方资源的攻防机制，打破了传统卡牌同质化的对局节奏，更考验临场的策略应对。
https://image.gcores.com/88fb484ceabac48805495b2ac1916e25-2560-1388.png
Demo 现已上线，限时测试招募中！
《恶魔召唤》免费 Demo 现已正式上线 Steam，欢迎大家前往下载试玩！如果你喜欢这款游戏，请务必将它加入心愿单！
https://image.gcores.com/6a56c1e50ba15e6cd96479d38055c247-1920-1080.png

此外，8月26日《恶魔召唤》将开启限时测试。 本次测试将开放 PVE 全新角色试玩，以及解锁全部卡池的 PVP 对战模式。无论你是对卡牌构筑有独到见解的老手，还是想抢先体验高交互博弈的玩家，我们都非常期待你的反馈。 请加入下方官方QQ群获得测试资格，在群内你可以第一时间匹配对局、反馈实战体验，与开发团队交流关于卡牌平衡与机制的建议。 🎮 Steam 商店页面： https://store.steampowered.com/app/4075830/_/
欢迎关注游戏官方社媒： 官方QQ群: 487110648 Billbill: 伏特加加_恶魔召唤 Bilibili: 机核发行

items.title: 在灰烬之上建立帝国：《后世更序》公布，末日题材大战略游戏
items.summary: Paradox Development Studio 十年来首个原创设定;预告片于 Opening Night Live 公布斯德哥尔摩/科隆 —— 2026 年 8 月 25 日 —— 战略与经营游戏开发商及发行商 P

others.title: P社新游官宣！末日题材大战略《后世更序》PV首曝

content.v: 在2026年科隆游戏展Opening Night Live发布会上，战略与经营游戏开发商及发行商Paradox Interactive公布《后世更序》（Afterworld），这是 Paradox Development Studio 开发的全新大战略游戏，即将登陆 PC 平台。游戏设定在原创的末日后北美：遍布危险地形、危险的旧世界废墟和绝望的人类残部。玩家将带领一小群幸存者踏上建立横跨大陆的帝国之路，面对战略挑战与道德危机。
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608260341366516.png
视频欣赏：
《后世更序》是 Paradox Development Studio，《十字军之王 3》与《钢铁雄心 4》的开发者，带来的全新大战略游戏，拥有深度且富含故事的末日背景。带领你的幸存者团结起来，定义部落的精神，建立你的帝国。这款游戏易上手，但难以生存——从规模小、易接近的开局，成长为丰富而复杂的战略体验，一如你对 Paradox 游戏的期待。
“Afterworld 是 Paradox 十年来第一个非历史题材的作品，我迫不及待想看到玩家用它讲述什么样的故事。”Paradox Development Studio《后世更序》游戏总监 Dan Lind 表示，“这是我们很久以来第一次从头构建的世界，也是第一次有幸能在游戏开始之前就把它毁灭掉。旧世界的碎片仍散落各处，等待被发现。它之后会发生什么，完全取决于玩家。”
《后世更序》将玩家置于程序生成的北美废土中，每次游玩都会创造一个全新的战略沙盒，涌现出不同的故事。玩家首先要面对搜寻食物、水和住所的挑战，同时重新发现文明的基本方法；随后是为日益壮大的部落制定法律与伦理的艰难抉择；最终与其他崛起的帝国正面对抗，决定这片大陆的命运。
《后世更序》核心特性：
在废土中重生，探索新的文明
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608260344311298.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608260344348197.jpg
•以从年久失修的核掩体中爬出的避难者身份，或是在尘原中寻找女神的狂热者身份，又或是其他几个可选起源之一，开始游戏。 在荒原中建立最初的定居点，并决定你的人民成为怎样的民族。
•在致命的环境中，勉强搜集食物、水和燃料。 寻觅稀缺资源，令队伍本就微薄的力量更显捉襟见肘；然而，在你的引导下，他们将掌握新技能、学会新方法，去提炼这片土地上失落的财富。
•探索一个程序生成的北美。 地形与地貌似曾相识，但资源、部落与威胁每一次都截然不同。每次游玩，都是一个充满涌现式故事的崭新战略沙盒。
•通过探索重新发现失落的科技。《后世更序》的动态科技树会根据你的实际发现和经历解锁新的进步。 遇到河流便学会灌溉。 接触新部落便发现有组织的宗教。 你的行动塑造了你社会可能的未来。
•组织车队和补给线以开发新发现的财富，或在土地干涸时举族迁徙。 你最初的定居点未必永远是首都，而劫掠对手始终是一个选项。
结伴出征还是独自作战
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608260344411022.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608260344459216.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608260344483112.jpg
•决定信任谁。 遭遇敌对部落，谈判交易，将流浪部落吸收进你日益壮大的国家，或用武力夺取所需。 他人既是你最大的资源，也是最大的威胁。
•起草新社会的律法。 决定谁能获得稀缺物资，谁能在领导层发声，以及你的国家为何而存续。 新的发现和危机将不断重塑你人民的需求，迫使你做出艰难抉择，这些抉择没有轻松答案。
•寻找陨灭前科技留下的强大遗迹，它们能重写你国家能力所及的规则——如果你能率先将其据为己有。 但要小心：终结旧世界的那种力量，同样也能终结新世界。
•在残酷竞争的多人模式或合作模式中，独自或与他人一同征服尘原。
捍卫帝国，重塑世界
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608260344588386.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608260344593687.jpg
https://img1.gamersky.com/upimg/pic/2026/08/26/small_202608260345013799.jpg
•在重新发现的美洲大陆上扩张。 随着领土被填满和资源枯竭，要么结盟，要么为控制所剩之物而进行残酷的战争。 第二次崩溃永远只隔着一个糟糕的决策。
•做出能回响数代人的抉择。 有成千上万的生命取决于你的决策，一次食物短缺可能导致一场饥荒，一次政治失误可能使你的国家分崩离析。 为了维系你的帝国，你愿意牺牲一切吗？
•揭开旧世界尘封的历史，直面重建的道德重压。 配给关键资源，驾驭新宗教的崛起，并决定你的社会如何对待变异者和改造人。 每一次危机都塑造着你帝国的灵魂。
•对抗古族——那些陨灭前依靠被遗忘科技得以永生的不朽领袖们。 他们对谁该统治有着自己的愿景，且不会悄然退让。
•定义你帝国的真正品格，追寻你的天命。 你会重拾旧道吗？ 寻求开明之路以避免重蹈过去的覆辙？ 你的帝国能否从灰烬之中巍然屹立？
玩家现可在Steam商店页面将《后世更序》加入愿望单
